title: Java Software Engineer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


**Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal**


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience ” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • College degree in IT Engineering or similar;
  • 4+ years of experience in Java development;
  • Experience with Spring frameworks (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security);
  • Experience with microservice architecture and cloud platforms;
  • Good English skills (minimum B2);
  • Availability to relocate to Portugal with our support.


Nice to have

  • Strong experience with Angular 2+.


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional skills and the will to acquire more;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;
  • Autonomy, proactivity, and focus (even under pressure);
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Versatility (you can be a fan of BYOD or not);
  • Ability to innovate and evolve in a market in constant mutation.


What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;
  • Being part of a technology focused on relationships, simplicity, and efficiency;
  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.


Do you think you're the one we are looking for?

Let’s chat ! Send your application and take a look at :

title: Advogado (a) Junior/Pleno ( Tempo Determinado)
description:
Oportunidade em TozziniFreire Advogados


QUEM SOMOS

TozziniFreire é um escritório full-service com atuação em 55 áreas do Direito Empresarial. Nosso compromisso com a integridade, a responsabilidade social, a diversidade e a inclusão está expresso em nossa missão e é reforçado diariamente em nosso desempenho.


INOVADORES ATÉ PARA INOVAR

Somos pioneiros no desenvolvimento de um programa de inovação interno, o ThinkFuture, para preparar nossos advogados para as transformações digitais, e referência jurídica em assuntos que envolvam tecnologia.


NOSSA ATUAÇÃO

Nossa equipe contenciosa é reconhecida pelo mercado e pelos principais guias nacionais e internacionais. O time tem vasta experiência nos diferentes setores, incluindo Consumidor, Tech Litigation & Data Privacy, em que assessoramos empresas com grandes relevâncias no mercado.


CONHEÇA A NOSSA VAGA

Para nós, a diversidade é peça fundamental do sucesso. Buscamos advogados Juniores e Plenos com experiência na área do Contencioso Estratégico. Atuará com demandas relacionadas ao Direito Eleitoral e Digital, não é necessário experiência nas matérias, mas será considerado como diferencial.

Contrato por tempo determinado (6 meses).

Local de trabalho: São Paulo – SP

title: Analista de dados sênior
description:
Requisitos Obrigatórios


Desenvolver e executar análises de dados de ponta a ponta para múltiplas áreas da empresa, incluindo operações, pagamentos e marketing, utilizando principalmente SQL , Google Sheets e Looker Platform . Criar, corrigir e otimizar tabelas, pipelines e regras de negócio, assegurando integridade, performance e escalabilidade. Usar métodos estatísticos e algoritmos de machine learning para criar modelos preditivos. Validar dados e indicadores críticos, investigando inconsistências e propondo melhorias. Colaborar com áreas de negócio, traduzindo análises em insights claros e acionáveis. Contribuir para boas práticas de versionamento e documentação utilizando GitHub . Experiência avançada em SQL e BigQuery ou SQL Server , além de experiência avançada em R . Habilidade para traduzir análises complexas em informações compreensíveis e proatividade para acompanhar indicadores.


Requisitos Desejáveis


Experiência em análises que envolvem múltiplas áreas de negócio. Vivência em GitHub , Looker ou outras ferramentas de data visualization . Capacidade de resolver problemas com foco em resultados para o negócio. Experiência em digital analytics com ferramentas como Google Analytics , Google Tag Manager e Appsflyer . Conhecimento em técnicas avançadas de ETL e transformação de dados .


Resumo dos requisitos: SQL , Google Sheets , Looker Platform , Machine Learning , GitHub , R , BigQuery , SQL Server , Google Analytics , Google Tag Manager , Appsflyer .

title: Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
Desenvolvedor Java Sênior


Como Desenvolvedor(a) Java Sênior , sua missão será atuar de ponta a ponta no desenvolvimento de soluções, participando da conceituação, desenvolvimento, testes e implantação de projetos existentes e de novas iniciativas.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Projetar e desenvolver aplicativos Web multiusuário eficientes, tanto para a execução no servidor como nos browsers, com possibilidades de instalação na nuvem;
  • Executar as atividades de todas as fases do ciclo do desenvolvimento e implantação dos aplicativos, usando metodologias ágeis;
  • Colaborar na definição da solução técnica aos requisitos de negócio, junto a área de produtos e junto aos clientes, implementando-a de forma eficiente e eficaz;
  • Criar códigos bem projetados, testáveis, eficientes, confiáveis, seguros e completamente aderentes às necessidades de negócio e com a arquitetura de referência corporativa. Aplicação de conceitos de reuso;
  • Desenvolver garantindo a qualidade e a manutenção do código, zelando pela documentação do mesmo e projetando/executando testes unitários e de integração.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Graduação Completa em: Tecnologia da Informação, Desenvolvimento de Software, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas em TI.
  • Experiência de 6 anos em desenvolvimento de aplicação Web (Web App);
  • Linguagem de Programação Java ;
  • Desenvolvimento frontend JavaScript, HMTL, CSS. Jquery e React;
  • Capacidade de interpretação do código-fonte elaborado por outros;
  • Experiência em Cloud AWS;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de versionamento GIT;
  • APIs Rest;
  • Conhecimentos em bancos de dados SQL;
  • Maven;
  • Persistência Objeto-Relacional (Hibernate, JPA);



REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS


  • Sistema de Identidade (Ex: KeyCloak)
  • Bibliotecas de Log (Ex: Log4J);
  • Container (Docker);
  • Atuação com frameworks Spring (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring);
  • Ter atuado em projetos utilizando metodologia ágil Scrum

title: AI Trainer
description:
We are looking for motivated individuals residing in Brazil to join our team as Freelance AI Trainers . This is an entry-level opportunity perfect for undergraduate students and freshers who are native Portuguese speakers and eager to contribute to the development of next-generation artificial intelligence.


Role Overview

As an AI Trainer, you will help improve the accuracy and quality of AI models by reviewing, labeling, and generating text-based content. Your insights as a native speaker are essential to ensuring the AI understands the nuances of the Portuguese language and Brazilian culture.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Labeling: Categorize and annotate text data to help the AI understand context and intent.
  • Content Evaluation: Review AI-generated responses for accuracy, tone, and grammatical correctness.
  • Writing & Rewriting: Create high-quality sample dialogues or prompts in native Portuguese.
  • Fact-Checking: Verify information to ensure the AI provides reliable and safe responses.


Requirements

  • Language: Native-level proficiency in Portuguese (written and verbal).
  • Location: Must be a current resident of Brazil .
  • Education: Currently enrolled in an undergraduate program or a recent graduate (Freshers are encouraged to apply!).
  • Skills: Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to follow complex guidelines.
  • Tech Savvy: Comfortable working with online platforms and basic productivity tools.
  • Equipment: Access to a reliable computer and high-speed internet.


Compensation & Benefits


  • Rate: $4 USD per hour .
  • Flexibility: Work from anywhere in Brazil with a schedule that fits your studies or other commitments.
  • Experience: Gain hands-on experience in the rapidly growing field of Artificial Intelligence.

title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
Cientista de Dados


Sobre a Arvo

Temos o propósito de tornar a saúde no Brasil mais acessível para todos. Nossa jornada começa com o uso de dados e inteligência artificial para reduzir fraudes, abusos e desperdícios em pagamentos de saúde. Acreditamos que a única maneira de alcançar isso é através de um time incrível, com pessoas apaixonadas por saúde e compradas na nossa missão de transformar o setor.


Perfil desejado

Buscamos uma pessoa cientista de dados com forte capacidade analítica, curiosidade e autonomia para explorar novos problemas e domínios. Alguém com perfil crítico e generalista, que se motive mais por entender e resolver problemas complexos com dados do que apenas por desenvolver modelos ou escrever código.

Procuramos alguém que combine rigor técnico e pensamento científico, com uma barra de qualidade alta. Que seja capaz de propor hipóteses, testar soluções de forma estruturada e entregar resultados robustos, bem validados e sustentáveis.


Responsabilidades

  • Analisar dados complexos e extrair insights que gerem valor para o negócio e para os clientes
  • Desenvolver relatórios, dashboards e visualizações de dados para comunicação de resultados
  • Identificar tendências, padrões e anomalias nos dados para apoiar a tomada de decisão estratégica
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de engenharia de dados para garantir qualidade, integridade e acessibilidade dos dados
  • Criar e documentar métricas de desempenho e indicadores-chave para monitoramento dos processos
  • Apoiar na definição de requisitos e especificação de soluções baseadas em dados
  • Realizar estudos de viabilidade e análise de impacto de soluções propostas
  • Comunicar de forma clara e objetiva os achados analíticos para diferentes stakeholders


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Formação em Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou área correlata
  • Conhecimento em Python
  • Experiência com análise de dados e geração de insights acionáveis
  • Experiência em manipulação e consulta de bancos de dados SQL e não relacionais
  • Boa comunicação para interagir com diferentes stakeholders e traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções analíticas
  • Experiência com modelagem estatística ou machine learning.


Qualificações Desejadas

  • Experiência na área de healthtech
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de ETL
  • Familiaridade com Google Cloud (GCP) e BigQuery


Descrição da vaga

Essa pessoa será responsável por analisar dados complexos da carteira de clientes, identificar padrões e oportunidades e traduzir insights em recomendações estratégicas. Trabalhará em parceria com os times de Business e Health, desenvolvendo relatórios e dashboards que apoiem a tomada de decisão. Também atuará junto à engenharia de dados para garantir a qualidade e acessibilidade das informações, além de definir métricas e indicadores para monitorar o desempenho das iniciativas.


Benefícios

Plano de Saúde Bradesco Saúde Nacional II (TNMI)

VA/VR: R$1.080 no Flash

Acesso ao wellhub (gympass)

Vaga remota

title: Analista de dados sênior
description:
Sobre a DataEX:

Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA , com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks , atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos a inovação, a colaboração, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a qualidade de vida , com incentivos para certificações e bem-estar.


Contexto do projeto:

A DataEX busca empresa/profissional autônomo para prestação de serviços técnicos especializados em projeto na área de Dados, com atuação junto a cliente de grande porte, no contexto de iniciativas de Análise de Dados. A eventual relação jurídica será formalizada mediante contrato civil de prestação de serviços, com autonomia técnica e operacional.


Perfil técnico esperado:

Vasta experiência em análise de dados e resolução de problemas complexos.

Experiência em mentorar equipes.

Profundo conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização e análise de dados (Power BI).

Experiência em desenvolvimento e implementação de estratégias analíticas.

Conhecimentos em modelagem dimensional.

Conhecimento em levantamento de requisitos.

Habilidades para atuar consumir dados Big Data.

Habilidades para consumir dados com Data warehouses (Amazon Redshift)

Habilidades para consumir com Datalake / Lakehouse (Amazon S3, Athena, Glue)

Conhecimento e experiência aprofundadas em ambientes e ferramentas AWS

Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de influenciar decisões estratégicas.

Espanhol avançado/fluente será considerado um diferencial!


Escopo de atuação:

Realizar e validar requisitos de negócio.

Realizar e validar a modelagem dimensional (conceitual, lógica e fisica).

Executar projetos analíticos, desde a concepção até a entrega.

Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de análise de dados.

Colaborar com líderes de negócios para identificar oportunidades de análise.

Apresentar insights e recomendações para stakeholders.

Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza a autonomia, a colaboração e o crescimento contínuo, com projetos desafiadores e oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento.


Nosso jeito de ser

  • Crescemos com responsabilidade
  • Valorizamos a diversidade e quem transforma

  • Inovação, conexão, confiança e antecipação de futuro


Se você busca desafios com significado, a Minsait é o seu lugar.



Descrição Geral do Cargo:


Você vai projetar e evoluir soluções de IA generativa para uso real em negócio, com foco em agentes, prompting, RAG e avaliação. Procuramos alguém que saiba transformar necessidade em solução robusta, com guardrails, qualidade e melhoria contínua.

Responsabilidades

• Desenhar agentes (agent workflows), ferramentas (tool calling) e prompts para casos de uso reais.

• Construir/evoluir pipelines de RAG (ingestão, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, grounding).

• Definir guardrails e políticas: segurança, privacidade, compliance, prevenção de alucinação.

• Criar estratégia de avaliação: métricas, datasets, testes automatizados, critérios de aceite.

• Otimizar qualidade e custo (latência, contexto, taxas de erro, cache, roteamento de modelos).

• Trabalhar em parceria com engenharia para produção (logs, auditoria, monitoramento, versionamento).

Requisitos obrigatórios

• Experiência prática com LLMs e IA aplicada (ex.: agentes, prompting, RAG).

• Boa base em Python e engenharia de experimentação (reprodutibilidade, testes, métricas).

• Conhecimento de técnicas de recuperação (vetores/embeddings, busca híbrida, rerank).

• Experiência ou familiaridade com avaliação de qualidade (offline/online) e redução de erro.

• Capacidade de comunicar decisões técnicas de forma clara para negócio e engenharia.

Diferenciais (desejáveis)

• Experiência no setor financeiro e/ou processos de risco, fraude, crédito, operações, compliance.

• Experiência com fine-tuning, eval frameworks e observabilidade de LLM.

• Vivência com ambientes regulados e requisitos de auditabilidade.

Espanhol

title: Creative Software Specialist - 64877
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for Creative Software Specialists experienced in open-source creative tools to produce structured digital content such as animations, illustrations, video, audio, layouts, or interactive scenes. The role requires clear documentation of the creative workflow and the ability to submit organized project files and outputs.


Requirements:

  • Strong English communication skills (written and spoken).
  • Computer with 16 GB RAM or more (mandatory).
  • Ability to operate Linux/Ubuntu in a virtual environment .
  • Proficiency in at least one of the following tools: Blender, OpenToonz, Synfig Studio, Pencil2D, Kdenlive, OpenShot, GIMP, Inkscape, Krita, Audacity, Scribus, or Godot .


Key Responsibilities:

  • Produce structured creative outputs (animation, video, graphics, audio, layouts, or game scenes).
  • Maintain native project files with organized layers, timelines, or assets .
  • Demonstrate workflow progression (draft → intermediate stages → final output).
  • Document tools, effects, logic, and project structure for reproducibility and review.
  • Export deliverables in appropriate formats (e.g., video, audio, images, vector files, or playable builds ).


Benefits:

  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : at least 4 hours per day and a total of 40 hours per week with 2-4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract: 16 weeks
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-4 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent automated analytical challenges.
  • Once you clear them, you are ready to go!

title: Scrum Master (Inglês Avançado)
description:
SAP Scrum Master – Ariba Buying Channel & S/4HANA Integration


Remote | CLT | Long-term engagement


SAP Scrum Master – Ariba Buying Channel & S/4HANA Integration

✦ Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como Scrum Master em times SAP focados em SAP Ariba Buying / Guided Buying.
  • Orquestrar Buying Channels (Guided Buying, Catálogos, Spot Buy), regras de aprovação e políticas de compra.
  • Coordenar integrações entre SAP Ariba e SAP S/4HANA , incluindo fluxos de compras, faturamento, impostos, fornecedores e contabilidade.
  • Facilitar cerimônias Agile, remover impedimentos e garantir previsibilidade das entregas.
  • Trabalhar de forma próxima com áreas como Procurement, Finance, Tax, IT Security, Master Data e fornecedores externos.
  • Assegurar aderência a SOX, GxP e requisitos de auditoria, especialmente em ambientes corporativos regulados.
  • Apoiar fases de hypercare, estabilização, planejamento de releases e melhoria contínua.


✦ Requisitos Esperados

  • Inglês fluente
  • Experiência como Scrum Master em projetos SAP, com atuação em Ariba.
  • Conhecimento sólido de processos Source-to-Pay / Procure-to-Pay.
  • Vivência com SAP Ariba Buying / Guided Buying , catálogos e workflows de aprovação.
  • Entendimento de integrações Ariba–S/4HANA (CPI, APIs, IDocs).
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos globais, complexos ou regulados.
  • Certificações Agile (CSM, PSM, SAFe) são diferenciais.

title: Desenvolvedor IBM RPA Sênior
description:
Objetivo da posição

Atuar no desenvolvimento, sustentação e evolução de automações utilizando IBM RPA , garantindo eficiência, escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade dos processos automatizados, além de contribuir com melhorias contínuas.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver automações de baixa e média complexidade, seguindo boas práticas e padrões de desenvolvimento;
  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva das automações implementadas;
  • Apoiar no suporte às automações, atendendo chamados de baixa e média complexidade;
  • Garantir o funcionamento adequado e a alta disponibilidade dos processos automatizados;
  • Participar de alinhamentos técnicos e discussões para melhoria contínua dos processos;
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares para evolução das soluções de automação.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Graduação completa ou em andamento em áreas de TI (Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação ou correlatas);
  • Conhecimento em lógica de programação e linguagens como Python ou similares;
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em ferramentas de RPA (preferencialmente IBM RPA );
  • Conhecimento básico em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados (criação de tabelas, SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE );


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de automações utilizando ferramentas low-code;
  • Vivência em squads de automação;
  • Experiência com suporte de automações e atendimento de chamados ponta a ponta.

title: Full-Stack Senior PHP Developer
description:
Are you passionate about building enterprise grade software applications that people depend on? Do you care that your work makes life better for people around the world? 


We’re building a Latam based fullstack software engineering team to scale and enhance our award winning cloud-based educational technology platform. After establishing a strong product with a fully remote U.S. team while 2xing revenue year over year, we’re now looking for the inaugural elite members to build and grow our Latam team. 


Consider this a unique opportunity to work with a U.S. based product company of top engineers and product executives, make an impact by improving education, and be part of a rocket ship!


About You


  • Versatile and hands-on doer, starter attitude
  • Empathetic and humble, you are respectful, optimistic, have the capacity to commit to disagreement when needed, and take ownership
  • Ability and willingness to work cross-functionally
  • Experience working with non-tech colleagues


Core Responsibilities


  • Develop PHP based features end to end
  • Address complex refactoring challenges in legacy PHP systems
  • Debug and repair broken or overly buggy code
  • Contribute to code reviews, QA, and an Agile development process
  • Participate in architectural planning and technical roadmapping


Must Have


  • 3+ years building full-stack applications with PHP backend
  • English Fluency
  • Experience writing front end JavaScript
  • Experience with SQL
  • API development expertise
  • Collaborative mindset with ability to work independently
  • Growth-oriented approach


Nice to Have


  • Modern PHP framework knowledge such as Laravel
  • Component-based JS framework experience
  • Cloud deployments experience
  • Test automation experience
  • Microservices development experience
  • Educational software or SaaS platforms expertise
  • Data integration expertise
  • Enthusiastic about learning and teaching others


What You’ll Get


An opportunity for uncommonly fast career growth. Work in a supportive, collaborative, and creative environment where you can thrive personally and professionally


  • Above market salary in local market
  • Flexible PTO and vacation policy
  • Flexible, family-friendly schedule to help you achieve work/life balance
  • Exposure to the US education technology industry
  • Exposure to industry C-suite executives and valuable networking experiences
  • Team up alongside a group of down to earth people looking to level up and build something big
  • Full-time remote position


We are an equal opportunity employer. No recruiters, please.


— FAQ —


What would be my career trajectory?


As a company, we have a very flat hierarchy. Your direct manager will be the VP of Engineering and his boss the Co-founder and Chief Product Officer. If you care about building experience by cultivating high-functioning teams, releasing great software, accomplishing goals, and learning new things, this is the right place for you. If you care about titles and meetings and titles, this is not the right place for you. Our belief is there will always be “the next job” so push yourself to learn and grow in the time you are here.


What is work like here?


We’re a Series B funded education technology platform. Think of us as a startup but without all of the early stage business and funding risks. It also means no corporate atmosphere with a strict dress code, and no stuffy bureaucracy to drown out your ideas. We value every team member and if we hire you, it’s because we think you can do great things with us. We aren’t going to sugar-coat everything. We have our challenges like every other business. Where we separate ourselves is having the willingness and motivation to take our challenges head-on before they grow.

title: Client Success Manager
description:
Client Success Manager

We are looking for a full-time, remote Client Success Manager with 4+ years of experience working in a software, technical recruiting, or technical outsourcing client services role. This role combines client advocacy with revenue responsibilities, focusing on retention and growth within existing client accounts.

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you will advocate for the client across all of Velozient and will play an integral role in our service delivery team.


Responsibilities

  • Develop strong client relationships built on high responsiveness and advocacy
  • Serve as the primary owner of account growth plans, including retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • Identify and close new sales opportunities within existing accounts, build job descriptions when necessary, and kick off new job recruiting efforts
  • Plan and execute successful client retention programs that drive loyalty and satisfaction measured by NPS and CSAT respectively
  • Review and submit candidates for open client jobs
  • Coordinate candidate interviews and gather feedback communicating next steps within the People Success (a.k.a., recruiting) and Account Management teams
  • Collaborate with account managers on key account activity
  • Conduct client onboarding sessions
  • Perform periodic health checks and ensure new resources are onboarded successfully with the client
  • Collaborate with People Success in investigating and resolving resource issues
  • Provide needed service information to clients including resource holiday calendars and answer general client inquiries
  • Coordinate and contribute to annual account review preparation and execution
  • Exhibit high integrity, a self-starter approach, and commitment to owning work outcomes


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations
  • 4+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a related customer-facing role within recruiting, staffing, SaaS, or professional services environments focused on software/technology
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership
  • Proven experience growing revenue within existing client accounts through cross selling or account expansion
  • Strong background conducting client onboarding, health checks, and business reviews to ensure successful outcomes and long-term engagement
  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Recruiting/Delivery, Operations, and Finance teams to drive client success and account growth
  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software engineering company providing outsourced software resources to North American companies. title: Client Success Manager
description:
Client Success Manager

We are looking for a full-time, remote Client Success Manager with 4+ years of experience working in a software, technical recruiting, or technical outsourcing client services role. This role combines client advocacy with revenue responsibilities, focusing on retention and growth within existing client accounts.

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you will advocate for the client across all of Velozient and will play an integral role in our service delivery team.


Responsibilities

  • Develop strong client relationships built on high responsiveness and advocacy
  • Serve as the primary owner of account growth plans, including retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • Identify and close new sales opportunities within existing accounts, build job descriptions when necessary, and kick off new job recruiting efforts
  • Plan and execute successful client retention programs that drive loyalty and satisfaction measured by NPS and CSAT respectively
  • Review and submit candidates for open client jobs
  • Coordinate candidate interviews and gather feedback communicating next steps within the People Success (a.k.a., recruiting) and Account Management teams
  • Collaborate with account managers on key account activity
  • Conduct client onboarding sessions
  • Perform periodic health checks and ensure new resources are onboarded successfully with the client
  • Collaborate with People Success in investigating and resolving resource issues
  • Provide needed service information to clients including resource holiday calendars and answer general client inquiries
  • Coordinate and contribute to annual account review preparation and execution
  • Exhibit high integrity, a self-starter approach, and commitment to owning work outcomes


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations
  • 4+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a related customer-facing role within recruiting, staffing, SaaS, or professional services environments focused on software/technology
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership
  • Proven experience growing revenue within existing client accounts through cross selling or account expansion
  • Strong background conducting client onboarding, health checks, and business reviews to ensure successful outcomes and long-term engagement
  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Recruiting/Delivery, Operations, and Finance teams to drive client success and account growth
  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Consultor(a) Dataviz SR
description:
Consultor(a) sênior para liderar soluções de visualização de dados com Power BI, integrado à stack AWS, atuando com times globais.


Principais atividades:

  • Projetar e evoluir dashboards e relatórios no Power BI com foco em clareza, consistência e performance.
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em visualizações e métricas (DAX/Power Query), definindo padrões e governança de dataviz.

  • Conduzir apresentações e workshops com stakeholders globais, promovendo insights acionáveis.

  • Experiência prática na stack AWS aplicada a dados/analytics.
  • Forte base em SQL, modelagem de dados e boas práticas de design de visualização.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente para participar de reuniões com times globais.

  • Atuação remota
  • Contratação CLT

title: Social Media Creator
description:
DesignRush.com, a B2B Media Platform that drives brand discovery & growth, is seeking a Social Media Creator with the vision and capability to increase our social following and traffic to our site from various social platforms.


Primary responsibilities:


  • Produce engaging social content relevant to our target audience and our brand
  • Substantially increase social media engagement and follower count
  • Drive traffic to the site


We offer GROWTH, job stability, and a work culture that enables our teammates to excel in their careers.


This is for a full-time, remote-work-at-home position.


DesignRush is seeking to make IMMEDIATE hires.


Responsibilities


  • Create a social media strategy and calendar for various social platforms
  • Develop and execute original ideas, scripts, and concepts end-to-end
  • Craft all creatives, including messaging, design, and video
  • Produce content focused on marketing and B2B topics to drive traffic and growth
  • Utilize AI to generate content ideas and help with execution
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Build and engage a professional online community through impactful content
  • Represent the brand consistently and professionally across all platforms
  • Optimize YouTube performance through SEO, thumbnails, and high-retention content
  • Use social trends (sounds, challenges, formats) to expand reach and visibility
  • Track and analyze performance metrics to continuously improve results


Requirements


  • 5+ years of experience creating content for YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram
  • Proven experience in B2B and/or media environments.
  • Strong copywriting and storytelling skills to produce engaging, on-brand content
  • Proficient in social media tools, analytics, and video editing software
  • Progressive thinker and avid user of AI
  • Passionate about communication, creativity, and making an impact
  • Able to work between 6 AM and 3 PM EST


Recruitment Steps:


  • Apply via LinkedIn
  • Complete a short questionnaire
  • Submit answers and CV
  • Interview with the Recruitment team
  • Complete a technical test
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager(s)
  • Receive feedback


We kindly ask for your CV and all correspondence to be in English.

title: SAP Product Costing
description:
Product Costing Consultant Expert

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Long Term Contract


Requirements

Education:

Required: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field

Preferred: Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, or MBA

Certifications: CPA, CMA, or other relevant professional accounting certification (preferred)


Experience:

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in product costing, cost accounting, or management accounting
  • Extensive hands-on experience with ERP systems, preferably SAP CO (Controlling) module with focus on Product Cost Controlling (CO-PC)
  • Proven experience in manufacturing or consumer goods industry with understanding of production processes and cost flows
  • Strong experience with standard costing, actual costing, and variance analysis
  • Demonstrated experience with month-end close processes, inventory valuation, and COGS calculations
  • Track record of leading costing system implementations or significant system enhancements


Preferred Experience:

  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA and Material Ledger functionality
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies
  • Experience in global, multi-entity organizations with complex transfer pricing scenarios
  • Consulting experience or Big 4 public accounting background
  • Experience with business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau, SAP Analytics Cloud)
  • Project management certification (PMP) or demonstrated project leadership experience
  • Experience with cost management in regulated industries
  • Knowledge of automation and RPA applications in finance processes


Technical Knowledge & Skills:

  • Expert knowledge of cost accounting principles and methodologies (absorption costing, activity-based costing, etc.)
  • Deep understanding of manufacturing cost structures including materials, labor, and overhead allocation
  • Proficiency in financial systems and tools (SAP CO-PC, SAP FI, SAP MM integration)
  • Advanced Excel skills including financial modeling, pivot tables, and data analysis
  • Knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS accounting standards related to inventory and cost accounting
  • Financial modeling and analysis capabilities
  • Data analytics and reporting skills
  • System configuration and testing expertise
  • Understanding of internal controls and SOX compliance requirements


Soft Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with exceptional attention to detail
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to explain complex costing concepts to non-finance stakeholders at all organizational levels
  • Strategic thinking and business acumen to connect costing insights with broader business objectives
  • Stakeholder management and collaboration skills across cross-functional teams
  • Project management and organizational skills with ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables in a remote environment
  • Change management capabilities to drive adoption of new processes and systems
  • Mentoring and training abilities to develop team capabilities
  • Continuous improvement mindset with focus on innovation and efficiency
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, dynamic environments with changing priorities

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Senior Oracle Project Manager – Oracle ERP & Legacy Ecosystems


We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, high-impact initiatives across Oracle ecosystems and legacy systems . This PM is focused on managing strategic improvement programs, regulatory adaptations (including Brazilian Tax Reform), system updates, enhancements, testing cycles, and the delivery of new functionalities in enterprise environments.


The ideal candidate demonstrates a proactive, dynamic, and ownership-driven mindset , with strong systemic and strategic vision, the ability to anticipate risks, and proven experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder projects.


Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Senior Project Manager in complex enterprise IT environments.
  • Strong background managing projects within Oracle ecosystems (Oracle EBS ERP and related solutions) and legacy systems .
  • Solid experience leading large-scale improvements, regulatory compliance initiatives, system upgrades, and testing programs .
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex stakeholder landscapes and executive-level communication.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end systems integration and dependency management .
  • Experience in environments with high regulatory and operational complexity .
  • Excellent leadership, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end project management for complex initiatives involving Oracle platforms and legacy systems .
  • Manage projects related to system improvements, regulatory adaptations (e.g., Tax Reform), upgrades, updates, testing cycles, and new functionality rollouts .
  • Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and executive leadership .
  • Drive governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and control of multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Anticipate risks, issues, and dependencies, proactively proposing mitigation strategies and corrective actions.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives, regulatory requirements, and technology solutions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional and multicultural teams, including internal teams, subcontractors, and partners.
  • Oversee scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk management.
  • Deliver clear, concise project communication, status reports, executive presentations, and decision papers.
  • Support strategic planning, roadmap definition, and prioritization of initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance, security, quality, and audit requirements.


Desired Profile

  • Proactive and dynamic professional with a strong sense of ownership .
  • Strategic mindset with strong systemic vision .
  • Ability to anticipate issues and risks before they materialize .
  • Results-driven, resilient, and adaptable to changing priorities.
  • Strong decision-making capability and accountability.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous and high-pressure environments.


Contract & Work Model

  • PJ (contractor) model
  • Long-term engagement: 1 year, renewable
  • Primarily remote, with sporadic national travel as needed

title: Associate Account Executive - Biopharma
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America. If you are ambitious, results-driven, and can develop relationships with scientists and progress opportunities, this position could be an excellent opportunity for you.


Responsibilities:


  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing business for assigned biopharma accounts.
  • Conduct active outreach to build and progress opportunities in the pipeline to meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Build and execute a persistent outbound sales strategy, including cold calls and emails, to generate interest and accelerate new business generation.
  • Establish and maintain strong and professional relationships with biopharma librarians, R&D leadership and stakeholders.
  • Work with the marketing and customer success teams to customize marketing activities & provide support for each account.


Requirements:


  • A bachelor's degree
  • 2+ years of direct selling experience to stakeholders in the pharmaceutical, biotech, device, or healthcare industry.
  • Demonstrated success in meeting and exceeding sales objectives.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and manage a full sales cycle.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • A disciplined approach to daily activity planning, setting goals, and achieving success.
  • Experience with Salesforce or relevant sales CRM, MS Office is required.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package, including unlimited commissions.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and productivity.
  • Opportunity to work in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America. If you are ambitious, results-driven, and can develop relationships with scientists and progress opportunities, this position could be an excellent opportunity for you.


Responsibilities:


  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing business for assigned biopharma accounts.
  • Conduct active outreach to build and progress opportunities in the pipeline to meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Build and execute a persistent outbound sales strategy, including cold calls and emails, to generate interest and accelerate new business generation.
  • Establish and maintain strong and professional relationships with biopharma librarians, R&D leadership and stakeholders.
  • Work with the marketing and customer success teams to customize marketing activities & provide support for each account.


Requirements:


  • A bachelor's degree
  • 2+ years of direct selling experience to stakeholders in the pharmaceutical, biotech, device, or healthcare industry.
  • Demonstrated success in meeting and exceeding sales objectives.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and manage a full sales cycle.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • A disciplined approach to daily activity planning, setting goals, and achieving success.
  • Experience with Salesforce or relevant sales CRM, MS Office is required.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package, including unlimited commissions.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and productivity.
  • Opportunity to work in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: UI Designer (Part-time)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $1,000 - $1,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a UX/UI Designer for a short-term contract (5–6 weeks at a part-time capacity) to support the design and evolution of a touch-first iPad application used by laboratory scientists to control equipment and analyze data in real time. The product is designed for non-expert users in lab environments and prioritizes speed, clarity, and reproducibility over visual complexity.


This engagement has two primary goals: defining UX for new feature development and supporting the adoption of updated iOS design guidelines.


Scope of Work:

New Feature Wireframes

You will define wireframes and UX flows for new features prior to development, ensuring alignment between product and engineering teams. These include:

  • A new navigation hub for multiple software modules, including clear handling of licensed vs. unlicensed states
  • A time-series data acquisition feature with configuration, live feedback, and playback for multi-dimensional datasets
  • Two new image analysis modules with consistent flows for launch, controls, results visualization, and save/discard actions
  • Enhancements to an existing analysis module to support additional configurations
  • A data export feature supporting multiple formats and destinations with error handling


iOS Design System Adoption

  • Review existing screens against updated iOS Human Interface Guidelines
  • Identify required updates for custom controls such as overlays, sliders, selectors, and timelines
  • Propose adaptations to align with new system design patterns while maintaining a professional, lab-focused interface
  • Ensure new designs are aligned with updated platform standards from the start


Expected Deliverables:

  • Annotated low- to mid-fidelity wireframes for all new feature flows, approved by the product
  • Design assessment and recommendations for updated iOS design system adoption
  • Final design files delivered in a format usable by the iOS development team


Required Skills:

  • 3+ years of experience as a UI/UX designer with robust experience designing for iPad applications.
  • Apple Platform Mastery: Deep familiarity with Apple HIG specifically for iPad , including expert use of split views, sidebars, popovers, and touch-target optimization.
  • iOS 26 Familiarity: Working knowledge of the Liquid Glass design system, including navigation bars, sheets, and modal presentations under the new paradigm.
  • Wireframing & Tools: Senior-level experience in producing annotated, implementation-ready wireframes using tools such as Figma or Sketch .
  • Scientific UI Experience: Experience designing interfaces where data precision and reproducibility are prioritized; prior work with medical, clinical, or industrial apps is a strong plus.


Team Fit & Work Style:

  • Ability to work from written requirements without dedicated UX research support
  • Self-directed and comfortable working in small teams
  • Comfortable working within established design systems rather than creating new visual languages
  • Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken
  • Experience working in distributed remote teams and async environments


Nice to Have:

  • Experience in laboratory, life sciences, or medical software
  • Experience working with design systems within the Apple ecosystem


Engagement: Short-term contract, 5–6 weeks at a part-time capacity (80 hours per month) with PST work hours overlap.


Timeline: Project kick-off scheduled for early May


*Please note our partner is only looking for part-time dedicated team members who are eager to integrate within their team

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

title: Senior Data Engineer (GraphQL / AWS)
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Engineer (GraphQL / AWS)

Location: Remote

Experience: 5+ Years

Employment Type: Full-Time


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in building scalable, cloud-based GraphQL API layers to deliver high-volume sports and betting data across multiple digital platforms.

In this role, you will design and implement robust data systems, enabling seamless data ingestion, processing, and delivery. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to build a federated GraphQL architecture , powering next-generation sports data experiences within the digital ecosystem.


Key Projects

  • Build a unified GraphQL API layer for seamless data access across platforms
  • Design and implement a core data platform for CBS Sports Digital products
  • Develop data pipelines integrating multiple sources and transport mechanisms
  • Implement distributed tracing systems for enhanced observability
  • Containerize services to improve scalability and reduce infrastructure overhead


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering or distributed data systems
  • Strong experience with GraphQL schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning
  • Proficiency in:
  • JavaScript / TypeScript
  • Python
  • Node.js
  • Experience with databases:
  • Relational (e.g., Aurora MySQL)
  • NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, MongoDB)
  • Key-value stores (e.g., Redis)
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services in high-traffic environments
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, Git, GitOps, and testing frameworks
  • Experience designing scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Apollo GraphQL, WunderGraph, or Cosmo
  • AWS Certifications
  • Experience building ETL pipelines and working with orchestration tools
  • Background in digital media, sports, or content platforms
  • Knowledge of sports data or gaming/betting systems

title: Analista de dados ETL |Projetos do (Mercado Segurador)
description:
LOUCOS POR INOVAÇÃO E TRANSFORMAÇÃO:

A .add é uma empresa de TI e inovação, com 25 anos no mercado. Estamos localizados no São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro e Miami.

Com atuação marcante no mercado brasileiro, desenvolvemos soluções eficientes de forma singular para entregar os melhores serviços e produtos nas áreas de Inovação e Tecnologia.

Nosso diferencial está na expertise de um time multidisciplinar e comprometido com as melhores práticas ágeis utilizadas para superar desafios corporativos e garantir resultados extraordinários com precisão, agilidade e segurança.

Tecnologia, Liderança, Agilidade, Inovação e Pessoas, são os pontos que formam a essência da .add.


Aqui na .add você vai encontrar:

• Ambiente colaborativo

• 100% Remoto

• Plano de Saúde

• Plano Odontológico

• Ticket Refeição e/ou Alimentação

• Seguro de Vida

• Circuito de treinamentos

• Programa de Educação Continuada

• Desafios e oportunidades de crescimento


Descrição da Vaga

Buscamos um Analista de Dados (Mercado segurador) com experiência sólida em rotinas de ETL para integrar nosso time de engenharia de dados. O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e otimizar fluxos de ingestão, transformação e integração de dados críticos do setor de seguros, com foco em governança de dados.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, manter e otimizar pipelines ETL/ELT utilizando ferramentas de ETL e bancos relacionais (SQL Server, PostgreSQL ou Oracle).
  • Implementar boas práticas de data ingestion , data quality e versionamento de fluxos .
  • Automatizar processos de extração e transformação de grandes volumes de dados provenientes de sistemas legados e operacionais.
  • Garantir a integridade e rastreabilidade das informações, aplicando padrões de governança e compliance .
  • Colaborar com times de negócio e tecnologia para modelar dados voltados ao mercado segurador , incluindo apólices, coberturas, sinistros, endossos e participantes.
  • Apoiar a equipe na definição de padrões de nomenclatura, documentação técnica e boas práticas de arquitetura de dados.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com Ferramentas de ETL , incluindo controle de versões, parametrização e uso de templates/process groups.
  • Domínio de SQL avançado e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência em projetos de integração de dados (ETL/ELT) em ambientes corporativos.
  • Conhecimento de modelagem de dados (relacional e dimensional).
  • Familiaridade com controle de versionamento (Git) e integração contínua (CI/CD) aplicada a pipelines de dados.
  • Boa comunicação técnica e capacidade de documentar processos de extração e transformação.


Desejáveis:

  • Experiência no mercado segurador , com entendimento de produtos, apólices e processos regulatórios.
  • Conhecimento prévio sobre o Sistema de Registro de Operações (SRO) da SUSEP.

title: Bussines Analyst
description:
Bussines Analyst - Strong FIX protocol

Duties: Acts as a partner with the business to facilitate and implement technology solutions. Responsible for writing technical database system specific requirements that will ensure the technology solution will meet the needs of the business and the firm’s enterprise data governance standards.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Gathers, interprets, and analyzes information from written documentation and in-person discussions. Gathers, interprets, and analyzes system data across multiple application stacks and data systems (e.g. Unix, FIX, Oracle, SQL Server, Mainframe). Creates detailed functional requirements (e.g. business processes, business rules, exception rules) using business appropriate terminology. Creates detailed non-functional (e.g. service level response times, system availability). Creates detailed service mapping and design requirements using actual technical database construct terminology. Executes development integrated testing to ensure that solution meets the requested business functionality. Prepare and validate test cases to ensure full coverage of the business functionality. Provides support for product management and application development teams including documenting business processes. Translates technical concepts to business audience and business information to a technical audience. Participates in developing estimates and implementation plans for technical solutions. Partners with team members to develop project schedules, reports, and documentation. May be required to act as project lead on small projects and/or provide direction to others on the team. Works with User Experience / Design resources to help visualize requirements into prototype. Provides updates to management on the status of requirements, project risk remediation, defect remediation, and project change requests. May occasionally work a non-standard shift including nights and/or weekends and/or have on-call responsibilities.

NOTES FROM THE HIRING MANAGER: Need to have experience with SQL query and UNIX log analysis and writing functional requirements for trading applications.

Skills: The candidate will contribute to the software development lifecycle of products and services from inception stage through to the final implementation. The candidate would be required to work closely with the developers & vendors to define, build and test the solution often working on multiple projects/work-streams at the same time.

Responsibilities include Creating and maintaining business requirements (functional & technical) in partnership and collaboration with the business and obtaining sign-off Responsible for creating functional solutions, conducting FSD walk-through and obtaining sign-off Work with data sourcing to source and validate data completeness from acquisition to report delivery. Responsible for working with the developers to ensure correct understanding of requirements and then owning the functional delivery end to end Defining testing requirements together with the Product Management team and Business SMEs and maintaining strong relationships with both to ensure alignment with business requirements and project management resources Ensure projects are completed according to product specifications and are properly documented. Work with Stakeholders during UAT to ensure reports meet requirements and ensure all deliveries are signed off.

Education: Bachelor’s degree (B.A.) in Computer Science, MIS or related degree and a minimum of five (5) years of relevant development, testing or engineering experience or combination of education, training, and experience.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Solutions Architect – Sao Paulo / Hybrid - Fluent French & English

(Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, Software Implementation, Solutions Architecture, SaaS, Architecture, API Integrations, REST, Web Services, CRM, eCommerce, ERP, OMS, Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant)


Our client is an exciting and cutting-edge fintech giant with a global presence. They have been a market leader within the fintech consultancy sector for many years and their worldwide client base has never been stronger, with significant growth in the last 12 months. They are looking for an experienced Solutions Architect to own the end-to-end solution design, implement their cloud-based space planning and design platforms and ensure solution integrity from discovery through deployment.


As an experienced Solutions Architect, you will be responsible for providing architectural oversight across multiple concurrent implementations and leading architectural discovery sessions with customer stakeholders. This will include designing end-to-end solution architectures across SaaS platforms, APIs, middleware, CRM, eCommerce, and Order Management systems.


Expert knowledge of cloud-based SaaS architecture and API integrations, such as REST and Web Services is essential, as experience leading enterprise-level software implementations. Experience working in multi-system ecosystems, such as CRM, eCommerce, ERP and OMS is also expected. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills are a must, as you will be acting as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers and presenting solution designs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You will also need to have excellent time and priority management skills that enable you to work in different time zones and speak and write fluently in French and English.


We are keen to hear from talented Solutions Architect candidates from all backgrounds.


This is a truly amazing opportunity to work for a prestigious brand that will do wonders for your career. They invest heavily in training and career development; top performers are guaranteed a career path into senior and lead positions within 12 months.


Location: Sao Paulo / Hybrid

Salary: 160k BRL – 190k BRL + Bonus + Pension + Excellent Benefits

Languages: Fluent in French and English


To apply for this position please send your CV to Karan Gajjar at Noir Consulting.

Our client is an exciting and cutting-edge fintech giant with a global presence. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills are a must, as you will be building collaborative partnerships with key customer stakeholders. You will also need to have excellent time and priority management skills that enable you to work in different time zones and speak and write fluently in French and English. This is a truly amazing opportunity to work for a prestigious brand that will do wonders for your career. They invest heavily in training and career development; top performers are guaranteed a career path into senior and lead positions within 12 months.

Salary: 160k BRL – 190k BRL + Bonus + Pension + Excellent Benefits

Languages: Fluent in French and English

title: Analista de Sistemas Java PL
description:
Código da vaga: 59709


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Java 11+ : Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento backend utilizando Java 11 ou superior.

Spring Boot : Domínio do framework Spring Boot para construção de aplicações e serviços.

AWS (API Gateway, VPC Link, NLB, ECS) : Vivência com arquitetura e operação de serviços na AWS, incluindo API Gateway, VPC Link, Network Load Balancer e ECS.

APIs REST (desenvolvimento e consumo) : Capacidade de desenvolver APIs REST e integrar sistemas por meio do consumo de APIs REST de terceiros.

Testes (unitários e performance) : Prática em testes unitários com JUnit/Mockito e execução/análise de testes de performance.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Gerente de produção
description:
Descritivo da vaga

Encarregado de Produção e Montagem — ED Ambientes | Ceilândia, Brasília-DF - Presencial

A ED Ambientes é uma empresa de móveis planejados com fábrica própria, atendendo clientes residenciais e comerciais no Distrito Federal desde 2015. Com mais de 1.000 projetos entregues, buscamos um profissional para liderar nossa operação produtiva — da fábrica à instalação no cliente.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Liberar e organizar diariamente as equipes de montagem externas, conferindo carga, rotas e materiais antes da saída
  • Acompanhar a produção interna na fábrica (seccionadora, coladeira, CNC), orientando a equipe e garantindo o fluxo do plano de corte
  • Monitorar remotamente as obras em andamento e dar suporte técnico às equipes de campo
  • Planejar o dia seguinte: separação de peças, definição de rotas, organização do cronograma das equipes
  • Avaliar solicitações de correção de projeto e coordenar com o setor de projetos via sistema (Trello)
  • Registrar e atualizar o status da produção com fotos e documentos no sistema interno

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência liderando equipes de 7 a 15 pessoas em ambiente de produção ou obra
  • Hábito de trabalhar com prazo como restrição central
  • Organização para gerir múltiplas frentes simultâneas (fábrica + campo)
  • Capacidade de leitura de projeto técnico ou disposição para aprender rapidamente
  • Comunicação clara e postura de resolver problemas no campo sem depender de escalonamento
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas digitais básicas (WhatsApp, planilhas, Trello ou similar)

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios):

  • Experiência com móveis planejados, marcenaria ou indústria moveleira
  • Conhecimento de máquinas de corte e beneficiamento de MDF

title: Analista de risco de crédito
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Conduzir estudos estratégicos para identificar dores de mercado relacionadas às etapas de atraso e oportunidades de otimização nos processos de cobrança, considerando buckets de atraso curto, médio e longo.

Aplicar soluções analíticas avançadas para análise de dados e geração de insights que aprimorem políticas de cobrança e estratégias de gerenciamento de risco.

Desenvolver e executar estratégias analíticas que apoiem a tomada de decisão ao longo de todo o ciclo de crédito, desde a avaliação de risco até a gestão de cobranças.

Demonstrar aos stakeholders a eficiência e impacto das soluções analíticas na gestão do ciclo de crédito.

Colaborar com equipes internas como Data Science, Plataformas, Vendas e Operações para evolução contínua das estratégias de cobrança.


Habilidades e Requisitos


Experiência necessária

Experiência comprovada em análise de dados aplicada a processos de cobrança, gerenciamento de risco ou ciência de dados.

Experiência com políticas de cobrança e estratégias de recuperação de crédito.

Capacidade de compreender necessidades de negócio e traduzi-las em insights analíticos aplicáveis ao ciclo de crédito.

Forte domínio em análise de dados, estatística e ferramentas de visualização, especialmente aplicadas ao contexto financeiro.

Experiência em políticas de desconto, cessão e precificação de carteiras de atraso (curto e longo prazo).

Formação superior em Estatística, Ciência de Dados, Matemática, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.


Hard Skills

BigQuery SQL – nível sênior

Python – nível sênior

Análise estatística e modelagem de dados

Manipulação e análise de grandes volumes de dados

Visualização de dados aplicada a crédito e cobrança


Formato de trabalho: Home office em SP

title: US Payroll Analyst
description:
The main objective of this role is to review payroll data and documentation for assigned clients, ensuring that all values are accurate based on employees worked hours, guaranteeing traceability and providing consistent, value-added support to clients.


Responsibilities:


  • Review quarterly and annual reports to ensure proper submission of payroll records to the IRS.
  • Input client-reported information for payroll processing.
  • Follow up with clients through meetings and emails to ensure that the information entered into ADP/Accountants World is accurate.
  • Enter information into the Accountants World platform for quarterly clients.
  • Review 1099 forms annually in accordance with information provided by Account Managers.
  • Perform all tasks related to the role based on knowledge and capabilities.


Education:


  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Accounting, or related fields.


Experience:


  • Minimum of 1 year supporting payroll processes.
  • Advanced English level – required.


Skills:


  • Customer Orientation
  • Attention to Detail
  • Learning Agility
  • Communication
  • Teamwork
