title: Market Data Database Support Engineer
description:
Company Description


Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide.


About the Role

We are looking for a highly analytical Market Data Database Engineer support a market data platform handling real-time financial data and time-series database .

This role is focused on production support, deep diagnosis, and database troubleshooting in a fast-paced capital markets environment , working closely with traders, vendors, and engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Perform advanced diagnosis and root cause analysis of production incidents related to market data systems
  • Support and troubleshoot time-series databases
  • Analyze data quality issues (missing, delayed, or incorrect market data)
  • Investigate system behavior using logs, queries, and system-level tools
  • Work with real-time data distribution systems (TREP / RTDS)
  • Validate data using tools such as Refinitiv SLang
  • Collaborate with vendors (e.g. London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) , Bloomberg) to resolve data-related issues
  • Support incident management processes and ensure timely resolution
  • Develop small scripts (Python/Bash/PowerShell) for troubleshooting and automation
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of monitoring, alerting, and support processes


Must-Have Skills

  • Strong experience in production support / application support
  • Proven expertise in diagnosis and root cause analysis (RCA)
  • Solid experience with databases (performance analysis, data validation)
  • Hands-on experience with debugging, troubleshooting, and log analysis
  • Good scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar)
  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to work under pressure


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in banking / capital markets / trading environments
  • Knowledge of market data systems (TREP / RTDS)
  • Experience with Refinitiv SLang
  • Familiarity with Process Monitor (ProcMon) or similar diagnostic tools
  • Exposure to Bloomberg or Refinitiv/LSEG data platforms


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong investigative mindset – you enjoy digging into complex issues
  • Ability to trace problems across multiple layers (data source → ingestion → database → application)
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work with global stakeholders
  • Structured and analytical thinking
  • Proactive approach to identifying and solving issues

What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented environment within a top global institution
  • Flexible working arrangements – fully remote or hybrid options
  • Continuous learning and certification opportunities
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Long-term career prospects with international exposure
  • Inclusive, multicultural team with regular knowledge-sharing and team events

description:
Make this the place where you grow!


Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Somos uma equipe de pessoas apaixonadas que impulsionam a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e muito mais. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e ServiceNow, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas – e para suas pessoas,

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar na análise, configuração e suporte aos processos do módulo SAP PM;
  • Elaborar especificações funcionais, cenários de testes e documentação técnica/funcional;
  • Participar de projetos, melhorias e integrações envolvendo o módulo PM;
  • Realizar suporte às áreas internas, garantindo estabilidade e evolução dos processos;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, garantindo alinhamento funcional e técnico.



Requisitos:

  • Experiência anterior como Consultor SAP PM (pelo menos uma vivência consolidada em projetos);
  • Experiência comprovada em;
  • Processos do módulo PM;
  • Configuração e parametrização;
  • Criação de especificações;
  • Integrações com outros módulos;
  • Vivência obrigatória com SAP S/4HANA;



Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimentos em SAP QM;
  • Noções de MRP e integração com áreas de planejamento.

Residir em Curitiba ou região, com disponibilidade para atuação em modelo híbrido.

title: Program Coordinator
description:
About Sofia Health

Sofia Health is a fast-growing wellness marketplace connecting clients with top health and wellness professionals. Through live classes, on-demand content, and 1:1 services, we’re making whole-person care more accessible and helping providers build thriving businesses.


Sofia Prime is our flagship wellness membership, offering 300+ live virtual classes every month focused on physical, mental, and emotional well-being—including yoga, meditation, fitness, tai chi, iRest, health coaching, and more.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Virtual Wellness Program Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of our Sofia Prime program. In this role, you’ll help with day-to-day operations, communicate with instructors, support clients, ensure a seamless experience for both sides of the platform, and help expand participation and engagement across the platform.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role ideal for someone passionate about wellness, tech-enabled solutions, and community building.


Responsibilities
  • Coordinate and publish weekly and monthly live class schedules
  • Communicate with wellness instructors to confirm availability, gather class details, and ensure timely updates
  • Provide basic support to clients and instructors (e.g., tech check-ins, live session support, FAQs)
  • Assist with monitoring class attendance and flagging any issues or trends
  • Help gather and organize feedback from members to improve class offerings
  • Collaborate with marketing and community teams to promote upcoming classes
  • Maintain accurate records and help ensure consistent program delivery


Requirements
  • 1–3 years of experience in wellness programming, admin coordination, virtual event management, or community support
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through
  • Comfortable using Zoom, Google Suite, and digital scheduling tools
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Enthusiastic, team-oriented, and passionate about wellness
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Bonus Points
  • Experience working at a health tech or wellness startup
  • Background in virtual wellness delivery or e-learning company
  • Familiarity with wellness programming tools and virtual event logistics

title: Travel Designer
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Travel Designer to plan and execute highly curated itineraries for a sophisticated and growing global clientele.

This is a client-facing role focused on delivering seamless, personalized service. The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of luxury hospitality, understands the expectations of affluent travelers, and can manage multiple requests while transforming travel inspiration into flawlessly executed journeys.

You will collaborate closely with internal teams and trusted global partners to ensure every trip reflects the highest standards of luxury and service.

Profile

You are passionate about travel, detail-oriented, and skilled at building strong relationships with discerning clients. You intuitively understand their preferences and expectations, delivering highly personalized journeys with professionalism and care. Every interaction you lead reflects a refined standard of luxury service.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build bespoke, end-to-end itineraries tailored to each client’s travel style and preferences
  • Create and maintain long-term client relationships through prompt, thoughtful communication and flawless planning experience
  • Provide expert destination guidance with a strong understanding of luxury hospitality standards
  • Oversee all aspects of trip planning, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and seamless execution

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in luxury travel design, high-end hospitality, concierge, account management, or another sector within the luxury industry
  • Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus)
  • Proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, able to manage multiple complex itineraries in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while maintaining exceptional service standards
  • CV in English

  • Provide expert destination guidance with a strong understanding of luxury hospitality standards

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in luxury travel design, high-end hospitality, concierge, account management, or another sector within the luxury industry
  • Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus)
  • Proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, able to manage multiple complex itineraries in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while maintaining exceptional service standards

description:

  • A dynamic, international environment where your impact truly matters.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (React.js & .Net)
description:
We’re looking for a Full Stack Developer to join our team, with a strong emphasis on frontend development using React and TypeScript. In this role, you’ll primarily focus on building high-quality user interfaces while also contributing to backend services built with .NET/C# when needed.

We value engineers who enjoy solving complex problems, take ownership of their work, and dive deep into understanding the business domain. You should be comfortable designing scalable service contracts, working with clean and maintainable data structures, and collaborating across teams.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain modern, scalable frontend applications using React + TypeScript
  • Collaborate on backend services and APIs using .NET / C#
  • Design and consume RESTful APIs
  • Ensure code quality through testing, code reviews, and best practices
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and technical improvements
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment


Requirements:


English:

  • Avanced or Fluent English comunication skills


Languages

  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript (ES6+)
  • Working knowledge of C#
  • Solid experience with HTML, CSS, and SCSS


Frontend

  • React (v18+), including functional components and hooks
  • State management with Redux / Redux Toolkit
  • UI frameworks such as Bootstrap / React-Bootstrap
  • Experience with AG Grid or similar enterprise-grade data grids
  • Testing with Jest and React Testing Library
  • Familiarity with Webpack or similar build tools


Backend

  • Experience with .NET 8 / ASP.NET Core Web API
  • Strong understanding of RESTful API design
  • Experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases


Tools & Practices

  • Proficiency with Git (branching, merging, code reviews)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI/CD)
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies


Nice to have:

  • Experience with Redux Saga or similar middleware
  • End-to-end testing using Playwright
  • Knowledge of MediatR / CQRS patterns
  • Validation frameworks like FluentValidation
  • Authentication/authorization with Auth0, OAuth 2.0, or JWT
  • Experience with Redis or distributed caching
  • Exposure to Kubernetes / Helm
  • Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform)
  • Cloud experience with AWS (e.g., Lambdas, Secrets Manager)
  • Observability tools like Datadog
  • Real-time communication using SignalR
  • Object mapping tools like Mapster or AutoMapper

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Company: OutfitMD

Department: Customer support

Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9AM - 5PM Eastern Time


Company Overview:

We are a rapidly growing telehealth and pharmacy platform, dedicated to delivering accessible, personalized care to our patients. As demand continues to grow, we’re looking for motivated and detail-oriented individuals to guide patients through their treatment journey and build lasting relationships. If you have experience in client success, patient support, or sales/influence and thrive in a fast-paced, patient-focused environment, we’d love to have you join our dynamic team.


Compensation & Benefits:

• Competitive commissions

• On-Target Earnings (OTE): 5k-8k/month

• Performance-based incentives

• Clear structure with defined goals

• Opportunity for growth with a competitive pay structure

• Work-from-home flexibility


Key Responsibilities:

• Onboard clients with ideation calls to get them excited about the process

• Make sure all clients are happy and always checking up on them

• Follow up with clients to ensure they are enjoying their experience

• Manage multiple clients in a fast-paced environment

• Consistently meet performance metrics related to sales and marketing


Requirements:

• Experience in a client success and sales role

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and performance-driven environment


If you are a results-driven individual with sales and customer success experience, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços IT do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!

Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.

Mandatory skills:

Estamos buscando um Senior Data Scientist com ampla experiência em Python, Machine Learning e conhecimento avançado em componentes AWS para liderar projetos de análise de dados e desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis.

Tecnologias como Deep Learning e GenAI serão consideradas diferenciais. Importante conter a tecnologia.

Conhecimento em GenAI (LLMs, Prompt Engineering, APIs como OpenAI, HuggingFace).

Inglês fluente.

Desirable skills:

Experiência com Deep Learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch). Experiência com modelos multimodais.

Experiência com a tecnologia chamada Kedro

Key responsabilities:

Design, build, and deploy cloud-native automation workflows, including:

Azure: Functions, Logic Apps

AWS: Glue Jobs, Lambda, Step Functions, S3

Develop and maintain Cortex XSOAR playbooks, integrations, Python scripts, and automation modules tailored to process automation scenarios.

Create cross-platform orchestration pipelines (e.g., XSOAR → Azure → AWS) to support data flows, enrichment, and workflow execution.

Build reusable automation templates and components for repeatability and rapid iteration.

Implement automation CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, etc.).

Ensure all automations adhere to ISRM quality standards, security requirements, and best practices.

Conduct testing, validation, and documentation of automation workflows.

Collaborate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement of the automation capability.

title: Coordenador Financeiro / Contas a Pagar
description:
Quem somos

A Valuement , parte do Grupo Mantu , é uma consultoria internacional especialista em Source to Pay. Atuamos com clientes globais , ajudando a aumentar a eficiência, reduzir custos e melhorar a performance em contas a pagar, gestão de fornecedores e processos financeiros internos.

O Grupo Mantu , fundado em 2007, possui mais de 12.000 profissionais em 60 países, com faturamento anual de aproximadamente 1 bilhão de euros. Com expertise em transformação empresarial, tecnologia, marketing digital e gestão de talentos, o grupo oferece soluções estratégicas e inovadoras para clientes em diversos setores e regiões do mundo.


Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um Coordenador Financeiro / Contas a Pagar para atuar diretamente com nossos clientes globais , identificando oportunidades de otimização, eficiência e melhoria de processos financeiros .


Suas responsabilidades:

  • Analisar e monitorar processos de contas a pagar dos clientes, identificando inconsistências, duplicidades e oportunidades de economia
  • Colaborar com equipes de Procurement e Financeiro dos clientes para otimização de pagamentos e contratos
  • Desenvolver KPIs e dashboards para acompanhamento da performance financeira
  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria contínua e automação de processos
  • Atuar como elo entre o cliente, fornecedores e stakeholders internos da Valuement


Seu perfil

  • Experiência comprovada em contas a pagar, tesouraria ou controladoria
  • Domínio avançado de sistemas ERP (SAP, Totvs, Oracle, etc.)
  • Excel avançado (fórmulas, tabelas dinâmicas, relatórios)
  • Forte capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes
  • Excelente comunicação para interações com clientes, fornecedores e áreas internas
  • Proatividade, autonomia e capacidade de influenciar stakeholders
  • Fluência em português; inglês é diferencial
  • Experiência em projetos de melhoria de processos financeiros e otimização de fluxos


O que oferecemos

  • Uma comunidade global com mais de 110 nacionalidades
  • Uma cultura baseada em confiança , onde 70% dos líderes-chave começaram em cargos de entrada
  • Um forte sistema de aprendizado com nossa Academia interna e mais de 250 módulos de treinamento
  • Um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, com encontros informais, atividades de team-building e eventos sociais
  • Compromisso sólido com Responsabilidade Social Corporativa (CSR) , especialmente por meio do programa WeCare Together


Se você é um profissional entusiasmado, focado em gerar impacto e deseja se juntar a uma equipe dinâmica e em rápido crescimento, adoraríamos receber sua candidatura!


Diversidade & Inclusão

A Valuement tem orgulho de ser uma empresa de oportunidades iguais . Estamos comprometidos em construir uma força de trabalho diversificada e um ambiente inclusivo. Por isso, recebemos candidaturas de todos os profissionais qualificados , independentemente de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, crenças, idade, estado civil, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica.

title: Assistente de marketing de design gráfico
description:
A KRM Criativos busca um(a) assistente de design gráfico para apoiar projetos de identidade visual e desdobramentos de marca. O projeto inicial envolve a criação de identidade visual e desenvolvimento de materiais impressos e digitais para um evento. A ideia é começar neste formato de contrato e, com boa sintonia, evoluir para uma parceria contínua.


A KRM já desenvolveu projetos para marcas e iniciativas como Bob Burnquist, XGames Club São Paulo, Vans, Monster Energy, New Balance, CBSK e Banco do Brasil, entre outras.


Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar a criação de identidade visual
  • Desenvolver peças para evento (digital e impresso)
  • Desdobrar layouts com consistência visual
  • Vetorização e refinamento de logotipos e elementos gráficos
  • Preparação e finalização de arquivos para produção
  • Apoio na resolução de demandas visuais do projeto
  • Utilizar inteligência artificial como apoio no processo criativo e produtivo


Requisitos

  • Conhecimento em design gráfico e branding
  • Domínio de Adobe Illustrator e Photoshop (InDesign é diferencial)
  • Boa noção de tipografia, hierarquia e composição
  • Habilidade de vetorização
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas visuais com autonomia
  • Familiaridade com uso de inteligência artificial no fluxo de trabalho
  • Portfólio com projetos relevantes


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com materiais para eventos
  • Conhecimento de fechamento para impressão
  • Inglês Intermediário
  • Formação em Design, Publicidade ou áreas correlatas


Formato

  • Contrato
  • Remoto
  • Possibilidade de continuidade após o projeto inicial


  • Candidaturas via mensagem direta no LinkedIn com portfólio e breve apresentação.

title: Analista de recrutamento e seleção
description:
Junte-se a nós no Orbia Building & Infrastructure: Onde o propósito ganha vida.


Você é movido por propósitos. Mentalidade de crescimento. Pronto para ampliar seu potencial. Bem-vindo ao negócio de Construção e Infraestrutura da Orbia, Wavin, onde nosso propósito de \"promover a vida em todo o mundo\" impulsiona toda a nossa equipe global.

Todos os dias, estamos pensando grande e trabalhando de forma inteligente para resolver alguns dos desafios mais difíceis que impactam o mundo. Seja facilitando a água potável para as comunidades, criando cidades resilientes ao clima ou projetando espaços de vida mais confortáveis, nunca nos contentamos com o \"bom o suficiente\" quando há uma oportunidade de tornar a vida melhor.

Onde o propósito ganha vida, ele muda vidas. É para isso que trabalhamos. E quanto a você?

Na Orbia Building & Infrastructure, promovemos a vida em todo o mundo construindo ambientes saudáveis e sustentáveis. E onde é que a nossa ajuda é mais necessária? Os lugares em que vivemos: cidades onde a água potável está vazando, o verde está desaparecendo, as ruas estão inundando após fortes chuvas e sistemas de esgoto desatualizados estão poluindo nossas águas subterrâneas. É hora de fazer parte do nosso time e ajudar a construir ambientes mais sustentáveis!

Estamos atualmente procurando uma Pessoa Analista de Recrutamento e Seleção Sr para se juntar a nós em Sumaré/SP .eSe você quer continuar fazendo a diferença e crescer em uma empresa com propósito, verifique os requisitos necessários e se inscreva.



Como Pessoa Analista de Recrutamento e Seleção Sr. você vai.

Identificar, selecionar e atrair candidatos potenciais alinhados com a cultura, visão e valores da organização, garantindo o suprimento do melhor capital humano suportando as áreas clientes a atingir os resultados.



Principais Desafios da função

  • Conduzir processos seletivos internos e externos de todas as unidades e níveis (Estagiários, aprendizes, operacionais, técnicos, administrativos, vendas e de liderança) conforme a PO - Procedimento Organizacional de Recrutamento e Seleção;
  • Garantir diversidade de gênero e idade nos processos seletivos conforme estratégia definida por Orbia;
  • Orientar outros colaboradores do RH e lideranças sobre as melhores práticas em R&S e métodos para os processos seletivos;
  • Avaliar e propor a participação em feiras de estágios, como estratégia de aproximação deste público;
  • Cumprir o SLA de recrutamento e seleção definidos na política de recrutamento e seleção;
  • Identificar e atrair candidatos PCD´s de acordo com as vagas abertas;
  • Conduzir o processo de R&S do programa Jovens Talentos, de acordo com as diretrizes do programa;
  • Realizar triagem de currículos, convocação de candidatos e garantir o retorno para participantes de processos seletivos em todos os níveis;
  • Acompanhar realização do processo de assessment de seleção para posições de liderança;
  • Analisar, gerar e reportar indicadores da área;
  • Realizar constante benchmarking de melhores práticas com o objetivo de retroalimentar os programas de R&S e propor melhores práticas e reduções de custo e tempo com R&S;
  • Gestão de fornecedores de recrutamento e seleção de mão de obra efetiva e temporária (contratos vigentes e avaliação de novos fornecedores) atendendo ao perfil solicitado por Orbia;
  • Efetuar pagamentos de fornecedores conforme contratos estabelecidos, garantindo a conformidade;
  • Gestão do Programa PRA VOCÊ, oportunidades internas e indicações, fortalecendo este canal de oportunidades internas e externas, provendo ações de sustentação junto com a área de comunicação corporativa


Como Requisitos Básicos, Você Deve Ter :

  • Superior Completo em Psicologia, Administração de Empresas ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência na condução de processos seletivos envolvendo: diversos níveis e para diversas áreas, elaboração de perfis, contato com consultorias de RH, entrevistas à distância;
  • Entrevista por competências;
  • Dinâmicas de Grupo;
  • Conhecimento em Instrumentos de seleção e avaliação de perfil;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de avaliação de perfil/assessment de candidato.


Você Se Destaca, Se Tiver:

  • Pós-graduação / MBA em gestão de pessoas ou afins


O que o Orbia Building & Infrastructure oferece?

Quer fazer a diferença trabalhando com um propósito? Aqui assumimos a responsabilidade uns pelos outros e pela nossa empresa. Continuamos corajosos na busca de riscos calculados que alimentam a inovação. E abraçamos a diversidade em perspectivas, habilidades e talentos para transformar a maneira como trabalhamos e o impacto que temos no mundo. Acima de tudo, incentivamos todos os nossos colaboradores a desenvolverem seus talentos e a se tornarem a melhor versão de si mesmos. Juntos, como uma equipe forte, crescemos e cumprimos nosso propósito todos os dias. Orbia B&I é o lugar para estar se você realmente deseja causar um impacto. Além de trabalhar com uma equipe profissional e entusiasmada em um ambiente internacional, oferecemos um pacote competitivo de remuneração e benefícios.

  • Plano de saúde para os colaboradores e sua família;
  • Garantimos 6 meses de licença maternidade e 20 dias de licença paternidade;
  • Durante a gestação, Isenção de qualquer tipo de cobrança de coparticipação de consultas e exames;
  • Auxílio creche durante os 03 primeiros anos da criança;
  • Todos os colaboradores efetivos e seus dependentes possuem convênio médico e pagamos 50% do valor dos medicamentos necessários para tratamentos;
  • Convênio odontológico para os colaboradores e sua família;
  • Parceria com a plataforma Moodar (descontos em terapia online);
  • Parceria com a plataforma Wellhub (academias físicas e aplicativos parceiros);
  • Refeição para os colaboradores, seja nos restaurantes internos nas fábricas;
  • Para colaboradores e familiares, temos convênios educacionais com instituições de ensino;
  • Desconto em produtos da marca para reformar com a melhor opção do mercado;
  • E por último, mas não menos importante um dia de folga no seu aniversário!


Faça parte do time Amanco Wavin e ajude construir ambientes mais saudáveis e sustentáveis!

title: Desenvolvedor de .NET Senior, Brasil
description:
We are tech transformation specialists, uniting human expertise with AI to create scalable tech solutions.

With over 8,000 CI&Ters around the world, we’ve built partnerships with more than 1,000 clients during our 30 years of history. Artificial Intelligence is our reality.


We are looking for a Senior .NET Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development and integration of complex software solutions focused on back-end development. This role will require working closely with a multicultural team spread across Brazil, Colombia, the UK, and the USA, with all communication conducted in English.


Key Responsibilities:

Design, build, and maintain back-end services using C#, ADO.NET, and SQL Server.

Implement and evolve SOAP and REST APIs, ensuring best practices and versioning standards.

Ensure service reliability through unit and integration testing, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.

Collaborate on integration between various systems and services, applying software design patterns.

Conduct code reviews and provide mentorship to junior team members.

Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends, applying them to improve existing solutions.

Contribute to CI/CD workflows and best practices to enhance development efficiency.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

Strong experience with .NET Framework and .NET Core in production systems.

Solid understanding of ADO.NET and SQL Server, with experience in database design and performance tuning.Hands-on experience with SOAP and RESTful services.

Proficiency in XML serialization/deserialization.

Experience with IA plattforms.

Strong understanding of software design patterns and best practices.

Effective communication skills and resilience in fast-paced, multicultural teams.

Advanced English proficiency.


Soft Skills:

Proactive ownership of tasks with a mindset for continuous improvement.

Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaborative team player who values shared success.

Ability to adapt to ambiguity and shifting requirements.


Nice-to-Have Skills:

Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure.

Familiarity with specification-driven development and agentic approaches to software development.

Exposure to Agile development methodologies.

If you are a seasoned back-end developer looking to take on complex challenges in a dynamic environment, we invite you to apply and become a part of our diverse team!


Our benefits:


-Health and dental insurance

-Meal and food allowance

-Childcare assistance

-Extended paternity leave

-Partnership with gyms and health and wellness professionals via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass;

-Profit Sharing and Results Participation (PLR);

-Life insurance

-Continuous learning platform (CI&T University);

-Discount club

-Free online platform dedicated to physical, mental, and overall well-being

-Pregnancy and responsible parenting course

-Partnerships with online learning platforms

-Language learning platform

And many more!


More details about our benefits here:


At CI&T, inclusion starts at the first contact. If you are a person with a disability, it is important to present your assessment during the selection process. See which data needs to be included in the report by clicking here . This way, we can ensure the support and accommodations that you deserve. If you do not yet have the assessment, don't worry: we can support you in obtaining it.


We have a dedicated Health and Well-being team, inclusion specialists, and affinity groups who will be with you at every stage. Count on us to make this journey side by side.

title: Desenvolvedor de .NET Senior, Brasil
description:
We are tech transformation specialists, uniting human expertise with AI to create scalable tech solutions.

With over 8,000 CI&Ters around the world, we’ve built partnerships with more than 1,000 clients during our 30 years of history. Artificial Intelligence is our reality.


We are looking for a Senior .NET Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development and integration of complex software solutions focused on back-end development. This role will require working closely with a multicultural team spread across Brazil, Colombia, the UK, and the USA, with all communication conducted in English.


Key Responsibilities:

Design, build, and maintain back-end services using C#, ADO.NET, and SQL Server.

Implement and evolve SOAP and REST APIs, ensuring best practices and versioning standards.

Ensure service reliability through unit and integration testing, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.

Collaborate on integration between various systems and services, applying software design patterns.

Conduct code reviews and provide mentorship to junior team members.

Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends, applying them to improve existing solutions.

Contribute to CI/CD workflows and best practices to enhance development efficiency.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

Strong experience with .NET Framework and .NET Core in production systems.

Solid understanding of ADO.NET and SQL Server, with experience in database design and performance tuning.Hands-on experience with SOAP and RESTful services.

Proficiency in XML serialization/deserialization.

Experience with IA plattforms.

Strong understanding of software design patterns and best practices.

Effective communication skills and resilience in fast-paced, multicultural teams.

Advanced English proficiency.


Soft Skills:

Proactive ownership of tasks with a mindset for continuous improvement.

Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaborative team player who values shared success.

Ability to adapt to ambiguity and shifting requirements.


Nice-to-Have Skills:

Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure.

Familiarity with specification-driven development and agentic approaches to software development.

Exposure to Agile development methodologies.

If you are a seasoned back-end developer looking to take on complex challenges in a dynamic environment, we invite you to apply and become a part of our diverse team!


Our benefits:


-Health and dental insurance

-Meal and food allowance

-Childcare assistance

-Extended paternity leave

-Partnership with gyms and health and wellness professionals via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass;

-Profit Sharing and Results Participation (PLR);

-Life insurance

-Continuous learning platform (CI&T University);

-Discount club

-Free online platform dedicated to physical, mental, and overall well-being

-Pregnancy and responsible parenting course

-Partnerships with online learning platforms

-Language learning platform

And many more!


More details about our benefits here:


At CI&T, inclusion starts at the first contact. If you are a person with a disability, it is important to present your assessment during the selection process. See which data needs to be included in the report by clicking here . This way, we can ensure the support and accommodations that you deserve. If you do not yet have the assessment, don't worry: we can support you in obtaining it.


We have a dedicated Health and Well-being team, inclusion specialists, and affinity groups who will be with you at every stage. Count on us to make this journey side by side.

title: Legal Writer
description:
U.S. Immigration Law Firm, Law offices of Jacob J Sapochnick is growing and developing law firm in the USA that specializes in business, employment, investment, and family immigration to the USA. The law firm is known for providing its best to the clients by offering creative and strategic legal solutions. We are looking for the new team member, legal writer, to join our team.


Responsibilities:


Legal Brief & Petition Drafting:

  • Preparing legal briefs , including personal statements, expert opinions, and supporting arguments .
  • Engaging in extensive drafting , developing persuasive and well-structured arguments tailored to each case.

Case Strategy & Implementation:

  • Collaborating with senior legal specialists and U.S. attorneys to understand and execute case strategy effectively.
  • Ensuring that all legal arguments align with case objectives and meet the highest professional standards.

Legal Research & Analysis:

  • Conducting in-depth legal research to identify relevant statutes, judicial decisions, and immigration regulations
  • Staying up to date with evolving immigration laws and policy changes to ensure compliance and accuracy.
  • Be creative in drafting – must have!!!

Document Review

  • Reviewing client-provided documentation , identifying missing materials
  • Ensuring petitions are fully prepared in advance for mid and final attorney reviews, facilitating timely submission.

Attorney Support & Quality Assurance:

  • Assisting attorneys in case preparation, including gathering supporting documents, drafting legal arguments, and compiling evidence .
  • Collaborating with team members to enhance the accuracy, clarity, and persuasiveness of all written materials .


Requirements:


·      Excellent grammar, spelling, and written English composition skills is a must.


·      B.A. Degree in Law or Political Sciences or English studies student or graduate.


·      Previous legal or immigration writing experience preferred.


·      Extraordinary research and creative writing skills in English.


·      High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and excellent proofreading skills.


·      Strong organizational skills; ability to work under pressure, work within competing deadlines, and prioritize workload effectively.


·      Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to quickly learn new applications.


  • Salary depending on experience from $ - $ .



Schedule:

  • 8-hour shift,
  • Monday to Friday
  • Remote work

title: Analista de Negócios Sênior
description:
Sobre a vaga


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Analista de Negócios (BA) para assumir um papel estratégico em nossos produtos de Emissão (NFS-e, CT-e, MDF-e e CIOT) e Pátio & Agendamento .


Responsabilidades:


  • Liderar o mapeamento de processos complexos e definições de regras de negócio.
  • Ser o braço direito do PO na priorização do backlog e decisões táticas do Roadmap.
  • Escrever requisitos detalhados e conduzir reuniões de refinamento técnico.
  • Garantir o compliance com novas tendências de mercado e regras fiscais.
  • Ser referência técnica e mentor para analistas Níveis I e II.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Formação: Graduação concluída em Logística, Administração, Contábeis, TI ou Engenharias.
  • Hard Skills: Experiência com ferramentas de documentação (Jira/Azure), SQL, APIs REST e modelagem BPMN.
  • Metodologias: Domínio de métodos ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou Lean) e visão de produto.
  • Soft Skills: Alta capacidade de negociação, escuta ativa e análise crítica.


✨ Diferenciais que brilham aos nossos olhos:

  • Experiência com sistemas TMS .
  • Conhecimento profundo em regras fiscais, tributação e reforma tributária.
  • Experiência em processos de pátio, portaria e agendamento.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Produtos.


Localização:

  • Blumenau/SC - (Modelo Híbrido).
  • Outros regiões: 100% remoto

title: Principal Solution Architect
description:
We are seeking a Principal Solutions Architect with a strong data background to lead the design and delivery of scalable, cloud-based data solutions.


This role is highly consultative — ideal for someone who can operate at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution, working directly with clients to define solutions, influence architecture decisions, and drive successful outcomes.


This is not a pure engineering role. We are specifically looking for someone who can engage with customers, lead conversations, and act as a trusted advisor — not just build.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead architecture and solution design for complex data-driven initiatives
  • Partner directly with client stakeholders to understand business needs and define technical strategies
  • Design and oversee implementation of data platforms leveraging Python, Databricks, and/or AWS
  • Translate ambiguous requirements into scalable, production-ready solutions
  • Provide architectural leadership across data engineering, data platforms, and analytics ecosystems
  • Act as a client-facing advisor , guiding best practices and influencing decision-making
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure proper execution and delivery


Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Solutions Architect / Principal Architect in data-focused environments
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python
  • Deep experience with Databricks, AWS , or similar modern data platforms
  • Track record of working in client-facing or consulting roles
  • Ability to lead technical discussions with both executives and engineering teams
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify complex concepts


Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in consulting firms or delivering solutions across multiple clients
  • Experience leading large-scale or enterprise data transformations
  • Exposure to data strategy, governance, or platform modernization initiatives

title: Data Engineer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience ” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • College degree in IT Engineering, Computer Science, or similar;
  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles;
  • Strong experience with data pipeline design and development (batch and streaming);
  • Proficiency in Python and/or Scala for data processing;
  • Experience with SQL and relational/non-relational data modeling;
  • Experience with big data frameworks (Apache Spark, Kafka, Airflow, or similar);
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms (Azure Data Factory, Databricks, AWS Glue, Redshift, or similar);
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and lakehouse architectures;
  • Familiarity with data governance and data quality practices;
  • Excellent English skills (C1/C2);
  • Availability to relocate to Portugal.


Nice to have

  • Experience with dbt, Delta Lake, or Apache Iceberg;
  • Familiarity with real-time/streaming architectures (Kafka, Flink);
  • Knowledge of BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar);


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

title: Data Analyst
description:
This is a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 13k-18k BRL/mo.


Must-Haves:

  • 2-5 years of experience in a data engineering/ analyst role
  • Experience with Python (ETL, transformations)
  • PySpark specifically (via Databricks)
  • Familiarity with pandas‑style transformations
  • Experience with SQL for database querying and management
  • Experience with Tableau
  • Strong visual storytelling
  • Ability to innovate and make dashboards genuinely usable


Nice-To-Haves:

  • Experience working with Databricks

Day to day:

A client of Insight Global is looking to hire a data analyst to join their team remotely in the LATAM region. This person will be responsible for partnering directly with business stakeholders to define KPIs, gather requirements, and deliver end to end data solutions. This person's main focus will be on enabling the business through clean data, strong analytics, and exceptional visualization. This person will not be maintaining existing pipelines, but building new ones to support the client's strategic initiatives.

Key responsibilities listed below:

  • Partner 1:1 with business stakeholders to:
  • Understand goals and initiatives
  • Define KPIs and success metrics
  • Perform end‑to‑end data work:
  • Identify and validate data sources
  • Transform data to align with business goals
  • Build net‑new ETL pipelines as needed
  • Develop dashboards and reporting in Tableau that:
  • Tell a clear story
  • Are visually polished and intuitive
  • Are suitable for senior leadership consumption
  • Create presentations and insights that support executive decision‑making
  • Operate in a project‑based environment with ownership from intake to delivery

description:
Como Desenvolvedor(a) FullStack Pleno na Sankhya, você atuará na tribo ERP Logística, contribuindo diretamente para a evolução e sustentação de sistemas críticos utilizados por grandes clientes. Essa frente é estratégica para a companhia, com forte exposição a demandas regulatórias, operacionais e ao relacionamento com áreas como Produto, Qualidade e PMO.


Você fará parte de um time que atua em manutenção de sistemas legados, propondo melhorias, identificando falhas e colaborando com a categorização e resolução de ordens de serviço (OS), com foco em performance, estabilidade e ganho de conhecimento funcional. Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora com visão de qualidade e espírito colaborativo, que além de codar, também se preocupe em testar, automatizar, validar e garantir a robustez das entregas. Este papel tem responsabilidade dupla: desenvolver e garantir a excelência técnica nas liberações, atuando de forma híbrida entre Dev e QA.



RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Desenvolver e manter funcionalidades de software com foco em qualidade, desempenho, manutenibilidade e experiência do usuário;
  • Participar da análise e interpretação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, colaborando com times de Produto, Qualidade e QA desde as fases iniciais;
  • Escrever código limpo, testável, organizado e aderente aos padrões técnicos da Sankhya;
  • Realizar manutenção corretiva, evolutiva e adaptativa em sistemas e rotinas existentes;
  • Investigar e corrigir erros, propondo melhorias com foco em performance, estabilidade e prevenção de falhas;
  • Colaborar com a automação de testes e validação técnica das entregas, contribuindo para a robustez das versões liberadas;
  • Apoiar o time na definição de critérios de aceite, estratégias de teste e validação de cenários críticos;
  • Participar da definição de estimativas de esforço e planos de entrega, com visão integrada entre desenvolvimento e qualidade;
  • Atuar ativamente nos ritos ágeis do time (como dailies, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas), promovendo uma cultura de melhoria contínua;
  • Registrar e manter documentação técnica clara das funcionalidades desenvolvidas ou modificadas;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento técnico, boas práticas e aprendizados com o time, fortalecendo a cultura de excelência e colaboração.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada como Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno(a), atuando em sistemas de média ou alta complexidade;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Java (com foco em orientação a objetos);
  • Conhecimentos nas principais API Java (java.util, java.util.stream, java.time, java.util.concurrent).
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis em frameworks de font-end como AngularJS ou React, além de HTML, CSS e JavaScript;
  • Familiaridade com banco de dados relacional como por exemplo: SQL Server e Oracle (consultas, tuning, modelagem e estrutura relacional);
  • Escrita de consultas avançadas (JOINs, índices) e análise de planos de execução
  • Experiência com versionamento de código utilizando GIT;
  • Desejável vivência com frameworks como Spring, JPA e aplicação de design patterns;
  • Interesse ou experiência prática em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD);
  • Conhecimento em testes unitários e ferramentas para sua implementação como por exemplo (JUnit e Mockito).
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e suas ferramentas (Robot Framework, CyPress, Postman).
  • Conhecimento em escrita de testes usando ferramentas como gherkin.
  • Mentalidade de qualidade: valorizamos profissionais que consideram a excelência técnica desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega, com atenção a performance, cobertura de testes e prevenção de bugs.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial no dia a dia de engenharia para apoio em diagnóstico de problemas, revisão de código, documentação técnica e aceleração de entregas, garantindo uso responsável e seguro das informações.

title: Senior iOS Developer – Push Provisioning (Apple Pay & Google Pay)
description:
A Yupii procura um Senior iOS Developer  para um projeto de curta duração focado na integração de push provisioning (Apple Pay & Google Pay) com SDK MeaWallet, em ambiente React Native.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Desenvolvimento Nativo: Experiência avançada em Swift ou Objective-C para iOS.
  • Integração de Bibliotecas: Histórico comprovado na implementação de SDKs e libs externas complexas.
  • Push Provisioning: Experiência prévia em projetos de implementação de Push Provisioning (Apple Pay ou similares).
  • Comunicação entre Tecnologias: Domínio técnico em criação de Bridges ou Method Channels para integração entre desenvolvimento nativo e híbrido (React Native, Flutter, etc.).
  • Frameworks Híbridos: Conhecimento fundamental do ecossistema de desenvolvimento híbrido.

Qualificações Complementares:

  • Experiência prévia no setor de Fintech ou sistemas de pagamentos.
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura de segurança para transações móveis

Valorizado:

  • Experiência com Google Pay provisioning
  • Experiência com MeaWallet SDK
  • Background em pagamentos / fintech


Modelo:

  • Projeto curto 
  • Início imediato
  • Remoto

title: Gestor Jurídico Tributário
description:
Requisitos:

Sólida experiência no contencioso judicial tributário e em contencioso tributário administrativo, federal e municipal;

Experiência com processo civil coletivo;

Experiência com Holding patrimonial;

Experiência com Gestão de equipe;

Experiência em Paralegal;

OAB Ativa.


Formação:

Graduação completa em Direito com especialização em Direito tributário;

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Gestão dos processos distribuídos por escritórios parceiros;

Controle dos prazos processuais, administrativos e internos;

Distribuição das demandas para a equipe;

Acompanhamento dos processos através do sistema de gestão CPJ;

Análise e confecção de contratos diversos;

Condução das reuniões com o cliente;

Suporte as áreas técnicas da empresa;

Confecção de parecer;

Atualização de relatórios para reporte a diretoria.


Perfil Comportamental Esperado

Buscamos profissionais que demonstrem organização, atenção aos detalhes e senso de responsabilidade, com resiliência para lidar com prazos e demandas simultâneas. É fundamental possuir maturidade profissional, com disciplina, proatividade, perfil hands on e foco em resultados. Valorizamos o alinhamento do discurso com a prática.


Benefícios:

Remuneração a combinar

Possibilidade de ingresso na sociedade

Plano de saúde (50%)

Seguro de vida sem custo

Previdência privada

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Desenvolvedor Front-end Angular e React + AWS


Desenvolver projetos utilizando React, Angular, Webview, AWS, Nestjs e Inteligência Artificial.

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Cloud Architect (brazil location)
description:
Senior Cloud Engineer / Cloud Architect (AWS)

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Experience: 8+ Years


  • Strong English communication skills (written and verbal) are mandatory
  • • Candidates must be comfortable working in an English-speaking environment
  • • Resumes/CVs must be submitted in English


We’re looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer / Cloud Architect to join our team and lead cloud initiatives across our infrastructure and platform environments. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both hands-on engineering and driving architectural decisions at scale.

You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams, architects, and senior stakeholders to design, build, and optimize secure, scalable, and cost-effective cloud solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead and design AWS cloud architecture aligned with business goals

• Build and manage infrastructure using Terraform (modular & reusable)

• Develop automation solutions using Python

• Design secure VPC architectures, networking, and hybrid connectivity

• Implement CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices

• Deploy and manage Kubernetes (EKS) workloads

• Troubleshoot complex cloud and infrastructure issues

• Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical excellence


☁️ Required Skills:

  • • Strong hands-on experience with AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM)
  • • Deep understanding of cloud networking (subnets, routing, NACLs, security groups)
  • • Advanced Terraform expertise (modules, remote state, environments)
  • • Strong Python scripting and automation experience
  • • Experience with Kubernetes / container orchestration
  • • CI/CD pipeline experience and Git workflows
  • • Strong architecture and problem-solving skills


⭐ Preferred Skills:

• Experience with Azure (multi-cloud exposure)

• Familiarity with GitOps tools like ArgoCD

• Hybrid or multi-cloud experience

• AWS Certifications (Solutions Architect / DevOps)


What We’re Looking For:

• Strong ownership and independent execution

• Ability to lead and influence technical decisions

• Passion for building scalable, secure cloud systems

Interested or know someone who’d be a great fit?

Feel free to reach out or share your resume at

title: Arquitetura de Rede AWS - 132142
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com (Rede/AWS).

Responsabilidades:

Profissional especializado em segurança para ambientes financeiros críticos, responsável por definir, especializado em conectividade híbrida e ambientes de baixa latência, responsável por projetar e validar arquitetura de rede entre AWS e ambientes on-premises, garantindo desempenho, resiliência e segurança para cargas de trabalho do PIX. Realização de comprovações (POCs) para migração de workloads PIX do mainframe para AWS.

  • Projetar arquitetura de conectividade híbrida (AWS e on-prem);
  • Definir estratégia de conectividade (Direct Connect, failover via VPN);
  • Planejar e validar testes de performance de rede (latência, jitter, perda de pacotes);
  • Projetar arquitetura VPC com sub-redes segmentadas;
  • Otimizar tráfego de rede para workloads críticos;
  • Definir estratégias multirregião e de recuperação de desastres;
  • Implementar mecanismos de alta disponibilidade e failover;
  • Integrar rede com plataformas de containers (EKS/ROSA);
  • Colaborar com equipes de segurança para proteção de rede

Requisitos :

  • Amazon VPC, AWS Transit Gateway, Route 53;
  • AWS Direct Connect e VPN;
  • Network Load Balancer (Camada 4);
  • VPC Flow Logs e observabilidade de rede;
  • BGP e roteamento avançado;
  • Arquitetura de alto desempenho e baixa latência;
  • Certificações: AWS Network Specialty.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com sistemas financeiros e de missão crítica;
  • Operação de ambientes com alto throughput (milhares de TPS);
  • Estratégias de failover ativo-ativo;
  • Considerações de rede para integração com HSM.

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Position Overview

Gemean is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Legal Assistant to support our legal, forensic, and investigative teams. In this role, you will assist with case preparation, document management, and coordination across legal and investigative matters. You will work closely with attorneys, analysts, and project managers to ensure efficient case handling, accurate documentation, and timely communication. This position plays an important role in maintaining operational efficiency and supporting complex litigation, investigations, and regulatory matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Assist legal teams with preparation and organization of case files, documentation, and supporting materials
  • Manage legal documents, correspondence, and records while maintaining accurate filing systems
  • Support document review processes and assist with organizing electronically stored information (ESI) for investigations and litigation
  • Coordinate with internal teams including eDiscovery, forensic analysts, and project managers on case-related tasks
  • Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, and maintain calendars for legal professionals
  • Assist in drafting routine legal correspondence, reports, and administrative documentation
  • Track case progress, deadlines, and important milestones to ensure timely execution
  • Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive legal information with discretion


Required Qualifications and Skills

  • Proven experience as a legal assistant, paralegal support professional, or in a similar legal administrative role
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Experience supporting legal, compliance, forensic investigation, financial, or Web3-related matters involving case documentation and administrative coordination
  • Strong organizational and document management skills with high attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency in common office and document management software tools
  • Ability to handle sensitive legal, financial, and investigative information with discretion


Additional Preferred Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred
  • Familiarity with eDiscovery processes and legal documentation workflows is advantageous
  • Knowledge of legal research methods and document review practices is beneficial
  • Exposure to forensic investigations or regulatory environments is a plus


About Gemean

Gemean is a global leader in forensic investigations, electronic discovery, and data analytics. We utilize advanced platforms like PythAI and cutting-edge data tools to interpret complex datasets, support legal cases, and fortify organizational compliance and governance. Our multidisciplinary approach enables us to deliver comprehensive, actionable insights tailored to our clients’ needs.

title: Desenvolvedor Back End Java
description:
Back End Java Developer Description

The ideal candidate for this role will have at least four years of experience building Java applications, most recently within a microservices architecture. Preferably, you will have a strong understanding of DevOps and deployment procedures within an AWS environment. However, any experience with containerization and continuous integration would be beneficial. Streaming protocols for VOD and live streaming technologies are bonus points!


The candidate will have a strong understanding and experience building Rest APIs, streaming protocols, and Microservices, often integrating with third-party software. They primarily focus on streaming solutions, digital security, and automation, working with Java 11, Spring Boot, AWS Lambdas, Docker, and CI/CD.


This is an opportunity to grow into a Lead or Principal engineer while working on some of the most complex solutions for the media and entertainment business.


Preferred Technical Skills for reference

- Programming: Languages Java, Python

- Operating systems: Linux, Windows 10, Mac OS

- Development Tools: Intellij Idea, VS Code, Vim

- Networking: REST, MQTT, gRPC, XMPP

- Technologies: Spring, Spring Boot, JPA, Liquibase, Querydsl, PostgresSQL, Redis, Hadoop, HBase, Apache Phoenix, Apache Spark, AWS SDK, Maven, Gradle, Git, Docker

- English Advance

title: SAP Technical Lead
description:
About SEW

Smart Energy Water (SEW) is the leading provider of cloud-based digital platforms that empower global energy, water, and gas providers. Our innovative AI-, ML-, and IoT-powered solutions deliver world-class Customer Experience (CX) and Workforce Experience (WX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.


Quick Highlights:

  • 420+ global clients across the U.S., Europe, Canada, Australia, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific
  • 1,550+ employees and growing rapidly
  • Millions of users engaged monthly
  • 150+ industry awards and global recognition from Forbes, Wall Street Journal, and LA Times


Searching for your dream job? We are a true global company that values building meaningful relationships and maintaining an enthusiastic work environment while fostering innovation and creativity. At SEW, we believe that everyone contributes to our success, and in return, we provide opportunities for them to learn new skills and build a rewarding professional career.


Summary

We are seeking a Senior SAP Technical Leader with deep expertise across SAP’s core and cloud platforms to design and deliver scalable, future-ready solutions for utility enterprises.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical design and implementation of SAP solutions across S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Service Cloud V2, and SAP IS-U
  • Architect clean core, upgrade-safe extensibility using ABAP, OData, RAP, and SAP-recommended extension frameworks
  • Define and execute integration strategies across SAP and non-SAP systems (APIs, events, middleware)
  • Design scalable, high-performance architectures that support enterprise and utility-specific requirements
  • Serve as the technical point of contact for complex initiatives, guiding development teams and solution partners
  • Ensure solutions align with SAP best practices, security standards, and long-term platform roadmaps
  • Optimize performance, reliability, and maintainability across the SAP landscape
  • Collaborate with functional leads, architects, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions


Required Qualifications

  • Extensive hands-on experience with SAP ABAP
  • Strong expertise in OData services, REST APIs, and SAP integration patterns
  • Proven experience implementing clean core–compliant extensibility
  • Deep knowledge of SAP IS-U in utility enterprise environments
  • Experience with SAP Service Cloud V2 and SAP CX integrations
  • Solid understanding of SAP BTP, including extension, integration, and API management services
  • Strong background in system integration, performance tuning, and scalability
  • Ability to lead technical discussions and influence architectural decisions
  • Utility industry experience
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English is mandatory
  • Fluency in Spanish is highly required


\"SEW is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.\"

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Transforme o futuro com a Minsait


Na Minsai t, acreditamos na tecnologia como força para transformar realidades e gerar impacto positivo. Desenvolvemos soluções que conectam inovação, eficiência e progresso em setores essenciais como administração pública, telecomunicações & mídia, energia & utilities, indústria & consumo, saúde e finanças.

Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza a autonomia, a colaboração e o crescimento contínuo, com projetos desafiadores e oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento.


Nosso jeito de ser

  • Inovamos com propósito
  • Crescemos com responsabilidade
  • Valorizamos a diversidade e quem transforma


Valores

  • Inovação, conexão, confiança e antecipação de futuro


Se você busca desafios com significado, a Minsait é o seu lugar.




Responsabilidades e atribuições:


Buscamos um Engenheiro de Dados com sólida vivência em ambientes desafiadores e dinâmicos, especialmente no setor financeiro. Este profissional atuará de forma estratégica e operacional em projetos de dados, sendo responsável por desenhar, construir e manter pipelines de dados eficientes e escaláveis que suportem tomadas de decisão baseadas em dados.


Responsabilidades e atividades do dia a dia:


Desenvolver e manter fluxos de ingestão, transformação e entrega de dados, garantindo que as informações estejam acessíveis, íntegras e atualizadas para os usuários de negócio.

Trabalhar em conjunto com analistas, cientistas de dados e equipes de negócio, compreendendo suas necessidades e traduzindo essas demandas em soluções de dados viáveis e eficientes.

Modelar dados estruturados e não estruturados, assegurando sua organização, governança e consistência ao longo dos projetos.

Garantir a qualidade dos dados, implementando processos de validação, auditoria e monitoramento contínuo.

Investigar e solucionar problemas relacionados à performance, falhas de pipeline e inconsistências nos dados, atuando de forma proativa para evitar recorrências.

Documentar processos, fluxos e regras de negócio aplicadas nas soluções desenvolvidas, promovendo a transparência e facilitando a manutenção dos sistemas de dados.

Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas e de alinhamento com stakeholders, comunicando de forma clara os avanços, riscos e limitações dos projetos em andamento.

Adaptar-se rapidamente a novos contextos e demandas, demonstrando curiosidade e iniciativa para aprender novas abordagens, padrões e boas práticas.


Python (Avançado )

SQL (Avançado )

PySpark (Avançado )

Databricks (Avançado )





TRABALHE NA MINSAIT


  • Modelo de contratação CLT.
  • Plano de Saúde subsidiado pela empresa para o titular.
  • Opção de inclusão de dependentes no Plano de Saúde com desconto em folha de pagamento.
  • Assistência Odontológica (opcional).
  • Vale Refeição no cartão Flash Benefícios.
  • Vale Transporte (opcional).
  • POP - Programa de Orientação Pessoal que visa oferecer suporte emocional e aconselhamento com orientação confidencial nas áreas psicológica, jurídica, financeira, social e pet sem custo para titular e dependentes legais.
  • Plataforma de Saúde Wellhub-Gympass (Acesso a mais de 700 academias em todo o Brasil com planos descontado em folha de pagamento).
  • Parcerias com grandes marcas de consumo.
  • Convênio com o SESC para titular e dependentes.
  • Convênios para descontos com instituições de ensino (graduação e pós-graduação) e escola de idiomas.
  • Seguro de vida em grupo.


Nosso compromisso com a diversidade é um elemento-chave da nossa cultura: Igualdade de oportunidades, respeito pelas pessoas e não discriminação são princípios de atuação para todos os profissionais da Minsait. Integramos o Bloomberg Gender-Equality Index (GEI) 2021 em termos de diversidade e igualdade de gênero.

title: Executive Assistant & Operations Coordinator
description:
I am seeking a highly organized, proactive Executive Assistant & Operations Coordinator to serve as the \"Engine of Execution\" for my real estate and investment business. This is a role for a detail-oriented professional who takes pride in being a \"Finisher\" —someone who excels at taking a project to 100% and ensuring nothing slips through the cracks.

As I scale my business from residential real estate into new investment sectors, I need a dedicated professional to manage the administrative landscape and help bring high-value proprietary projects to life. You will be the point person for transforming ideas and half-executed plans into successful, market-ready results.


Key Responsibilities
  • Project Implementation: Take ownership of internal initiatives and proprietary content. You will be responsible for the final organization, polishing, and execution of business projects to bring them to completion.
  • Operational Support: Manage the day-to-day administrative heartbeat of the business, including high-level scheduling, document management, and transaction support.
  • Bilingual Communication: Act as a professional point of contact for international clients and investors, ensuring all correspondence in English and Portuguese meets the highest industry standards.
  • Business Growth Coordination: Execute the tactical steps required to scale business operations into new markets and asset classes.
  • Accountability: Proactively identify \"stalled\" tasks and implement systems to ensure all professional priorities remain in motion.


Required Qualifications
  • The \"Closer\" Mentality: A proven ability to manage complex tasks and see them through to a successful conclusion. You are naturally organized and results-driven.
  • Bilingual Mastery: Flawless professional-grade fluency in English and Portuguese (written and verbal).
  • Professional Experience: 3–5 years of experience in administrative, project coordination, or real estate/finance roles.
  • Technical Proficiency: Skilled in Google Workspace and project management tools (e.g., Asana, Trello, or ClickUp).
  • High Level of Discretion: Ability to handle sensitive business information and proprietary projects with absolute confidentiality.


Compensation
  • We offer a competitive salary for the Brazilian market, with a clear path for performance-based increases as projects are successfully launched and business goals are met.

title: Staff ML Engineer - Contract
description:
Signify has partnered with a key client who is currently hiring a Staff ML Engineer to drive the productionisation and scaling of ML systems.


Staff ML Engineer (Contract)

Remote | 3–6 months | ASAP Start

Location - Remote - (The team is based on the East Coast)


What you’ll do

  • Own end-to-end ML productionisation (deployment → serving → monitoring)
  • Build and scale batch & real-time model serving systems
  • Develop feature pipelines & feature serving infrastructure
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML (build, test, deploy)
  • Manage model lifecycle (versioning, retraining, rollout/rollback)
  • Ensure performance, reliability & observability (SLAs, logging, alerting)
  • Troubleshoot production issues & optimise ML systems


What they need

  • 7+ years in ML Engineering / MLOps / Data Engineering
  • Strong experience deploying ML models into production at scale
  • Hands-on with Databricks, MLflow
  • Strong coding skills (Python essential, Scala/Java nice to have)
  • Experience with AWS/Azure, Docker, Kubernetes
  • Solid understanding of ML systems, pipelines & lifecycle management
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CDK)


If you are interested in this role, then please apply or send me a message.

title: Data Analyst V
description:
Título da posição: Data Analyst V BRL

Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência

Modelo de trabalho: Home office


Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.


O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.

title: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR


Descrição do Cargo:

Será responsável por projetar e implementar pipelines de dados robustos, utilizando DBT e tecnologias do ecossistema Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, LookerML, etc.). Além disso, deverá atuar com ferramentas ETL, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados utilizando DBT , com otimização de macros e templates.

Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Google Cloud (BigQuery), garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL.

Implementar e manter processos de ETL , garantindo qualidade e governança dos dados migrados.

Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados.
