  • Garantir que o produto entregue eficiência operacional, boa usabilidade, adoção e resultados mensuráveis.
  • Conduzir ou apoiar atividades de discovery, como entrevistas, análise de fluxos, validações e testes de hipótese.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia e design para construir soluções práticas e centradas no usuário.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho do produto, métricas de uso, feedbacks e resultados operacionais.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos produtos, equilibrando necessidades regulatórias, operacionais e de experiência do usuário.
  • Atuar como principal referência da squad em decisões de escopo, priorização e direcionamento funcional.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, Product Owner Sênior ou função equivalente em produto.
  • Vivência sólida em ambientes ágeis, com atuação junto a squads multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência no segmento de saúde, healthtech, operações clínicas, sistemas médicos ou contextos correlatos.
  • Forte compreensão de fluxos de saúde, especialmente relacionados a consultas médicas, rotina do médico, agendamentos, jornada do paciente e necessidades assistenciais.
  • Capacidade de compreender o que o médico precisa em termos de sistema, processo e usabilidade, mesmo quando a demanda não vem totalmente estruturada.
  • Experiência na escrita de histórias de usuário, definição de critérios de aceitação e gestão estruturada de backlog.
  • Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia.
  • Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico,
  • agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais.
  • Familiaridade com requisitos regulatórios, privacidade e compliance no setor de saúde.
  • Experiência com integrações entre sistemas de saúde e interoperabilidade.
  • Vivência com médicos, clínicas, hospitais, centros diagnósticos ou operações assistenciais.
  • Experiência com discovery e desenho de serviços em contexto de saúde.
  • Conhecimento de métricas relacionadas à eficiência clínica, fluxo de atendimento, adoção e performance operacional.


Competências esperadas

  • Forte senso de dono sobre o produto
  • Excelente capacidade de priorização
  • Visão de negócio com foco no usuário
  • Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar demandas em backlog acionável
  • Escuta ativa e boa facilitação
  • Empatia com médicos, pacientes e equipes operacionais
  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos
  • Pensamento estruturado para solução de problemas
  • Tomada de decisão orientada a valor e impacto
  • Alto nível de autonomia e accountability


O que esperamos de sucesso nessa posição


  • O roadmap do produto reflita prioridades reais do negócio e da operação em saúde.
  • Médicos e usuários clínicos percebam que o produto apoia, e não dificulta, a rotina do dia a dia.
  • Os requisitos estejam claros o suficiente para permitir execução eficiente pelo time de tecnologia.
  • As entregas gerem ganhos concretos de eficiência, qualidade operacional, adoção e experiência do usuário.
  • A squad tenha clareza sobre prioridades, contexto e objetivos de negócio.


Diferencial importante

Buscamos alguém que não apenas conheça produto, mas que tenha sensibilidade para entender a lógica do ambiente médico, conseguindo traduzir necessidades assistenciais e operacionais em soluções digitais de alto valor.

description:
A Idealtec atua há 19 anos no mercado de automação industrial , desenvolvendo soluções inovadoras para o setor. Estamos em constante evolução e buscamos um(a) profissional para somar ao nosso time administrativo, contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento sustentável da empresa.


Responsabilidades:

  • Auxiliar na reformulação administrativa e financeira da empresa;
  • Gerenciar contas a pagar e a receber ;
  • Realizar conciliação bancária ;
  • Elaborar e analisar demonstrativos de resultados ;
  • Controlar o fluxo de caixa e apoiar o planejamento financeiro ;
  • Apoiar a tomada de decisões estratégicas com base em análises financeiras.
  • Gestão de Ponto:  Realizar o controle, conferência e fechamento do relógio ponto;
  •  Gestão de Terceiros:  Administrar e auditar horas e medições de prestadores de serviço;

  • Benefícios:  Gestão de benefícios (Vale Transporte, Vale Refeição, Plano de Saúde, etc.);
  • R&S:  Apoiar processos de Recrutamento e Seleção (triagem e entrevistas iniciais);
  • Onboarding:  Realizar a integração de novos colaboradores e gestão de documentos admissionais/demissionais.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em Administração de Empresas, Finanças, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada na área financeira ;
  • Pacote Office (nível intermediário);
  • Excel avançado (obrigatório);
  • Inglês intermediário (desejável);
  • Diferencial: formação ou experiência em gestão de RH

title: LLM Scientist
description:
We are looking for an \"LLM Scientist \" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing.


Key Responsibilities

Design and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters.

Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.

Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.

Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.

Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.


Qualification Required

Extensive experience with PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).

Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.

Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.

Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS SageMaker/GCP Vertex Al).

Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.


Nice to Have

Advanced Degree: A Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.

Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.

Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).

Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public GitHub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the GenAl space.

Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.


About Our Client

Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards.


Benefits & Wellbeing

Compensation for this role is determined based on competitive market data and may vary depending on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications. Specific details will be discussed during the interview process.

The company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees’ well-being, financial security, and professional development. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plan contributions, paid time off, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for career growth, in accordance with company policies and applicable local regulations. It is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country of employment.

Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.

Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.

Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.

Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.


Qualification Required

Extensive experience with PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).

Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.

Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.

Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS SageMaker/GCP Vertex Al).

Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.


Nice to Have

Advanced Degree: A Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.

Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.

Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).

Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public GitHub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the GenAl space.

Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.


About Our Client

Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards.

title: Back End Developer
description:
Job Title: Back-end engineer / Platform Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)


Mandatory Skills:

  • GraphQl
  • API
  • Node
  • Typescript


Required Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years of software engineering or backend development experience Strong experience with API development (GraphQL and REST)
  • Solid understanding of database design and optimization (SQL & NoSQL) Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS or OCI)
  • Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) Proficiency in at least one backend language: Java (Spring Boot), Python, Node.

  • Work with cloud services on AWS or OCI to build scalable, reliable systems Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize application and database performance Participate in architecture discussions and mentor junior engineers

title: Mobile Developer SWIFT | SR
description:
Descrição da vaga

Como um desenvolvedor Apple Sênior, será esperado de você uma capacidade técnica e analítica profunda sobre o que já foi implementado no projeto, bem como fortes atributos voltados ao acompanhamento e evolução dos desenvolvedores mais júniores.

Como um profissional mais experiente, é esperado que você possua bastante conhecimento a ser compartilhado

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Conhecimento sólido em Swift;
  • Experiência em alguma arquitetura (exemplos: MVVM, VIPER, VIP);
  • Conhecimento sólido em criação e gerenciamento de dependências (exemplos: Cocoapods, SPM);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git);
  • Experiência na implementação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Experiência com consumo de APIs (REST, GraphQL e outros);
  • Experiência na criação de layouts com storyboards, xibs, autolayout, viewCode e SwiftUI em diferentes resoluções de tela;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban e outros);
  • Conhecimento de design patterns (Singleton, Factory e outros);
  • Experiência com testes unitários, interface e instrumentais;
  • Experiência com Code Review;
  • Experiência com Firebase, Google Analytics e Crashlytics;
  • Experiência com documentações;
  • Experiência com performance e otimizações

title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
ASSESSOR DE INVESTIMENTOS (AAI) – ANCORD OBRIGATÓRIA | PROSPECÇÃO ATIVA | MODELO 100% REMOTO


Somos um escritório contratado do banco BTG Pactual, o maior banco de Investimentos da América Latina!


Somos focados em trazer proximidade e personalização de serviços, sempre visando melhor atender os objetivos financeiros dos nossos clientes.


Como parte dos nossos planos de expansão, estamos em busca de novos Assessores de Investimentos em todo o território nacional.


Nossa cultura organizacional valoriza a autonomia, o acompanhamento e a flexibilidade para os vinculados.


Oferecemos um modelo de trabalho completamente remoto, utilizando a tecnologia a nosso favor, a fim de promover agilidade, acessibilidade e qualidade de vida para todos os envolvidos em nossos planos de negócios!


Somos intrinsecamente vinculados ao campo da Educação, com parcerias importantes neste setor, a fim de promover aprimoramento crescente de nossos serviços e da carreira dos nossos associados.


Aqui você irá encontrar um ambiente leve e colaborativo, pois acreditamos que é esta a ética de trabalho que nos leva a qualidade e excelência em serviços financeiros!




Sobre o Cargo


  • Ofertar assessoria de investimentos personalizada, com foco na confiança e assertividade;
  • Oferecer serviços, estratégias e os melhores caminhos para atender as necessidades especificas de cada cliente;
  • Estar sempre atualizado sobre as tendências de mercado, a nível regional, nacional e internacional;
  • Realizar análises assertivas e contextualizadas com perfil do investidor;
  • Trabalhar com leads estratégicos e com a prospecção de clientes em potencial;
  • Tornar-se especialista no portfólio do BTG Pactual, produzindo os melhores resultados a nível pessoal e coletivo do escritório.

title: Talent Management Administrator
description:
About the Role:

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Talent Management Administrator to join our global HR team. This role will focus on performance management, manager enablement, compensation administration, and cross-functional HR support. The ideal candidate will have strong problem-solving skills, experience in HR operations, and the ability to support managers in driving performance and development initiatives.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Manage performance review cycles in Teamflect (setup, monitoring, reporting).
  • Maintain training materials and enablement resources for Resource Managers.
  • Support compensation cycles (data validation, SAP updates, bonus letters).
  • Provide HR operational support across performance management, L&D, and compensation.
  • Partner with managers and HR stakeholders to improve processes and adoption.


Qualifications:


  • Experience in performance management programs and manager enablement.
  • Familiarity with HRIS tools (Teamflect, SAP, Payfactors).
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills (Excel pivot tables, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Excellent communication and analytical skills.
  • Experience in global HR operations is a plus.


Why Join Us?


  • Opportunity to work in a global HR function.
  • Exposure to leadership development and succession planning initiatives.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Full remote work flexibility
  • Work with cutting-edge technologies in a dynamic, collaborative team
  • Birthday bonus
  • Independent contractor
  • Access to 500+ lifelong learning courses and development opportunities
  • Fast-track leadership growth paths for senior professionals
  • Open-door policy with a global, inclusive team culture

title: IT Business Analyst
description:
IT Business Analyst – Sao Paulo / Hybrid - Fluent French & English

(IT Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, IT BA, Technical BA)


Our client is an exciting and cutting-edge fintech giant with a global presence. They have been a market leader within the fintech consultancy sector for many years and their worldwide client base has never been stronger, with significant growth in the last 12 months. They are looking for an experienced IT Business Analyst with a technical background to play a pivotal part in shaping customer solutions, supporting discovery, mapping requirements, designing integrations, and ensuring high-quality delivery across multiple projects.


As an experienced IT Business Analyst, you will be responsible for providing architectural oversight across multiple concurrent implementations and leading architectural discovery sessions with customer stakeholders. This will include designing end-to-end solution architectures across SaaS platforms, APIs, middleware, CRM, eCommerce, and Order Management systems.


Expert knowledge of solution design, application and infrastructure planning is essential, as is experience in technical software implementation for Enterprise level customers. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills are a must, as you will be building collaborative partnerships with key customer stakeholders. You will also need to have excellent time and priority management skills that enable you to work in different time zones and speak and write fluently in French and English. The use of AI to expedite tasks is also expected.


We are keen to hear from talented IT Business Analyst candidates from all backgrounds.


This is a truly amazing opportunity to work for a prestigious brand that will do wonders for your career. They invest heavily in training and career development; top performers are guaranteed a career path into senior and lead positions within 12 months.


Location: Sao Paulo / Hybrid

Salary: 160k BRL – 190k BRL + Bonus + Pension + Excellent Benefits

Languages: Fluent in French and English


To apply for this position please send your CV to Karan Gajjar at Noir Consulting.

title: Business Analyst - Banking Core
description:
About Stefanini LATAM Digital

Stefanini LATAM Digital is a global leader in technology and digital transformation, specializing in premium nearshoring services. We bridge the gap between top-tier Latin American talent and innovative global enterprises. By combining deep technical expertise with cultural alignment and agile methodologies, we empower our partners to scale their digital initiatives efficiently and effectively across borders.


The Role

We are seeking a highly experienced Business Analyst (BA) to join our team and support critical initiatives within our Core Banking systems. This professional will serve as a vital bridge between business objectives and technological execution, ensuring requirement clarity, cross-team alignment, and the high-quality delivery of solutions within an Agile framework.


Key Responsibilities


1. Strong Core Banking Domain Expertise (Critical)

This is the biggest differentiator.

  • Hands-on experience with:
  • DDA Accounts
  • Savings Accounts
  • Money Market Accounts
  • Certificates of Deposit (CD)
  • Understanding of banking processes + system integrations


2. Advanced Requirements Management & Translation

  • Ability to bridge business ↔ tech
  • Translate complex business needs into clear technical specifications
  • Perform deep-dive analysis , not just surface-level documentation


3. JIRA Mastery (Operational Backbone)

  • Not just usage — expert-level proficiency
  • Managing:
  • Backlog
  • Documentation
  • Workflow tracking


• Experience Level: Specialist (5+ years of experience). • Language Skills: Full fluency in both Portuguese and English.

• Core Banking Expertise: Extensive experience with banking systems, specifically covering DDA Accounts, Savings Accounts, Money Market Accounts, and Certificates of Deposit (CD).

• Agile Proficiency: Hands-on experience working within Agile teams and a strong understanding of banking processes and system integration.

title: Full-Stack Senior PHP Developer
description:
Are you passionate about building enterprise grade software applications that people depend on? Do you care that your work makes life better for people around the world? 


We’re building a Latam based fullstack software engineering team to scale and enhance our award winning cloud-based educational technology platform. After establishing a strong product with a fully remote U.S. team while 2xing revenue year over year, we’re now looking for the inaugural elite members to build and grow our Latam team. 


Consider this a unique opportunity to work with a U.S. based product company of top engineers and product executives, make an impact by improving education, and be part of a rocket ship!


About You


  • Versatile and hands-on doer, starter attitude
  • Empathetic and humble, you are respectful, optimistic, have the capacity to commit to disagreement when needed, and take ownership
  • Ability and willingness to work cross-functionally
  • Experience working with non-tech colleagues


Core Responsibilities


  • Develop PHP based features end to end
  • Address complex refactoring challenges in legacy PHP systems
  • Debug and repair broken or overly buggy code
  • Contribute to code reviews, QA, and an Agile development process
  • Participate in architectural planning and technical roadmapping


Must Have


  • 3+ years building full-stack applications with PHP backend
  • English Fluency
  • Experience writing front end JavaScript
  • Experience with SQL
  • API development expertise
  • Collaborative mindset with ability to work independently
  • Growth-oriented approach


Nice to Have


  • Modern PHP framework knowledge such as Laravel
  • Component-based JS framework experience
  • Cloud deployments experience
  • Test automation experience
  • Microservices development experience
  • Educational software or SaaS platforms expertise
  • Data integration expertise
  • Enthusiastic about learning and teaching others


What You’ll Get


An opportunity for uncommonly fast career growth. Work in a supportive, collaborative, and creative environment where you can thrive personally and professionally


  • Above market salary in local market
  • Flexible PTO and vacation policy
  • Flexible, family-friendly schedule to help you achieve work/life balance
  • Exposure to the US education technology industry
  • Exposure to industry C-suite executives and valuable networking experiences
  • Team up alongside a group of down to earth people looking to level up and build something big
  • Full-time remote position


We are an equal opportunity employer. No recruiters, please.


— FAQ —


What would be my career trajectory?


As a company, we have a very flat hierarchy. Your direct manager will be the VP of Engineering and his boss the Co-founder and Chief Product Officer. If you care about building experience by cultivating high-functioning teams, releasing great software, accomplishing goals, and learning new things, this is the right place for you. If you care about titles and meetings and titles, this is not the right place for you. Our belief is there will always be “the next job” so push yourself to learn and grow in the time you are here.


What is work like here?


We’re a Series B funded education technology platform. Think of us as a startup but without all of the early stage business and funding risks. It also means no corporate atmosphere with a strict dress code, and no stuffy bureaucracy to drown out your ideas. We value every team member and if we hire you, it’s because we think you can do great things with us. We aren’t going to sugar-coat everything. We have our challenges like every other business. Where we separate ourselves is having the willingness and motivation to take our challenges head-on before they grow.

title: Analista de Middleware Sênior (PJ)
description:
Atividades:

Conduzir salas de War Room para resolução de causa raiz de problemas ligados a Produção, atuando diretamente no ambiente, organizando a linha de troubleshooting, fomentando possíveis soluções de correção definitivas e/ou alternativas, consolidando e comunicando o report para o cliente e gerência;

Identificar problemas relacionados a aplicação e suas camadas e arquitetura e solução (APACHE, Weblogic, Banco de Dados, Load Balance, Redes e etc) e suas integrações com sistemas de front end;

Resolução de problemas de alta complexidade e identificação de RCA;

Colaborar com a gestão de TI e controles internos na sustentação de sistemas, visando priorizar as principais TIRs (melhorias);

Fomentar e elaborar propostas para otimizar e automatizar processos operacionais a partir da análise de cuasa raiz dos eventos que afetam a Produção;

Analisar tendências de incidentes/problemas e propor soluções preventivas bem como a solução definitiva;

Propor automações e monitorações que antecipem cenários de problema;

Implantar soluções de IA, ML e automações que antecipem problemas e atuem na resolução de maneira, cada vez mais assertiva e rápida;

Instalação de upgrades, manutenção e monitoramento de sistemas/processos;

Análise de perdas e ganhos de KPI (Key Performance Indicator) dentro da área de produção;

Elaboração de IOPs (Instruções Operacionais) para resolver possíveis Gaps de projetos e melhorar experiência do cliente;

Análise de perda de SLA (Service Level Agreemente) por meio de PowerBI e e Banco de dados para fluxo de vendas, que impactam diretamente a experiência do cliente;

Monitoração dos ambientes de produção, através de ELK Stack, Grafana, Zabbix, Kibana;

Melhoria contínua do fluxo de produção em nível operacional, através de correções de problemas por INCs, BUGs e TIRs;

Disponibilidade de horário e escala 24x7.


Conhecimentos específicos:

Seja formado na área de exatas, preferivelmente sistemas de informação ou informática e afins;

Ótima capacidade de comunicação oratória e escrita, principalmente em cenários de WR com executivos;

Experiencia em ambientes com WebLogic, Containers Docker e Kubernets;

Experiencia em ambientes com banco de dados;

Experiencia em troubleshooting envolvendo camadas de infra como Redes, Balanceadores, Firewall;

Experiencia em manutenção de aplicações hospedadas em cloud;

Experiência em camada de observabilidade;

Experiência em ambiente UNIX/Linux e Windows;

Experiencia em suporte a aplicações de Ordering e Integrações;

Experiencia em análise de logs, mapeamento de ofensores e direcionamento de causas raiz;

Experiencia em operação de contratos com KPIs e SLAs;

Comunicação padrão Soap/Rest e análise de Json/XML;


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

Seja um perfil de dinâmico, “falador”, que conduza os troubleshootings, que fale nas salas, se incomode com os problemas e busque alternativas para resolvê-los.

Experiência em ordering, gateway e facilidade de compreensão do end to end;

Operação em sistemas de integração;

Experiencia em implantação de Automações e IA efetivamente;

Experiência em empresas de Telecom;


Contratação: PJ.

title: Solutions Architect – Data Services
description:
Job Title: Solutions Architect – Data Services

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Through December 2026 (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks , data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh , data products , and Unity Catalog–based governance . This is a hands-on architect role , requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities


Solution & Data Architecture

  • Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration).
  • Design and implement data mesh architectures and domain-oriented data products.
  • Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog , including security, lineage, and multi-workspace strategies.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions.
  • Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks.


Data Platform Design & Governance

  • Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks.
  • Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies.
  • Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards.


Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts

  • Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk.
  • Remain hands-on with:
  • Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation
  • C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services
  • Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment.


Collaboration & Delivery Alignment

  • Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction.
  • Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs.
  • Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.


Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers.
  • Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design.
  • Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.


Architecture Documentation

  • Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation.
  • Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows.
  • Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs.


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks .
  • Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products.
  • Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage).
  • Solid programming experience in Python and/or C# , including API and integration design.
  • Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations.
  • Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead .
  • Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe) and PI Planning.
  • Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid.


Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders
  • Leadership and mentorship capabilities
  • Continuous learning and innovation mindset

- Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Dados em projetos sobre Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

- Vivência com arquiteturas modernas de Data Lake em cloud, incluindo padrões de camadas de dados (medallion ou equivalente).

- Vivência com ferramentas de ETL/ELT e integração de dados.

title: [Tech] Engenharia de Software Backend Pleno - Java
description:
Descrição da vaga

Atuar em equipe ágil no desenvolvimento e sustentação de produtos digitais, entregando valor de forma contínua e com qualidade, utilizando boas práticas de engenharia de software, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a estabilidade das soluções em produção.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, colaborando para manter um ambiente saudável e produtivo entre os membros da equipe;
  • Desenvolver e evoluir os produtos com foco em qualidade, utilizando testes automatizados e realizando revisões de código entre pares (code review);
  • Corrigir eventuais problemas nos sistemas com base na priorização definida pelo Product Owner, assegurando a satisfação dos clientes e usuários;
  • Realizar deploy em ambiente de produção utilizando processos de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD), garantindo a estabilidade da aplicação;
  • Propor melhorias técnicas e participar ativamente da evolução da arquitetura dos sistemas;
  • Garantir a segurança e a qualidade das entregas, respeitando os padrões estabelecidos pela equipe;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas parceiras (DevOps, QA, Produto) na busca por soluções robustas e escaláveis.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo ou cursando na área de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Programação orientada a objetos (POO);
  • Linguagem Java (preferencialmente versão 8 ou superior);
  • Spring Framework (Core, Boot, Data, etc.);
  • Criação de APIs RESTful;
  • Controle de versionamento com Git;
  • Arquitetura baseada em microsserviços.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Vivência com mensagerias (Kafka, RabbitMQ);
  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Desenvolvimento orientado a testes (TDD, BDD);
  • Criação de testes de integração e de carga;
  • Utilização de containers (Docker);
  • Orquestração com Kubernetes;
  • Banco de dados NoSQL (MongoDB);
  • Uso de cache (Redis);
  • Vivência com atuação em times ágeis e em ambientes de alta disponibilidade.

title: Senior AirTable Engineer
description:
Senior AirTable Engineer

Brazil

Software Engineer II


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We are seeking a Senior Airtable Engineer with a proven track record in designing, architecting, and scaling mission-critical business systems built on Airtable. This is a hands-on technical role focused on building and maintaining robust, secure, and scalable Airtable-based operational platforms that power loan origination, underwriting, servicing, and internal workflows. The ideal candidate combines strong Airtable architecture expertise with automation, API integrations, third- party software integrations, data modeling, and process design skills, and can collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into elegant, efficient, scalable systems.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Design, architect, and maintain scalable Airtable bases and data models supporting loan origination, underwriting, servicing, capital markets, and operations;
  • Build advanced Airtable automations, scripts, and integrations using Airtable Scripting, JavaScript, and APIs;
  • Develop and maintain integrations between Airtable and third-party systems (e.g., CRM, loan management systems, document management platforms, accounting systems, and data warehouses);
  • Propose and deploy best-in-class third-party software integrations to support required business workflows and technical programming that are limited using native Airtable functionality exclusively
  • Implement data governance standards including permissions, access control, field-level security, naming conventions, and documentation;
  • Optimize Airtable performance, scalability, and reliability for high-volume transactional workflows;
  • Collaborate closely with Operations, Capital Markets, Finance, Data & Quality, and Engineering teams to gather requirements and implement scalable solutions;
  • Support system monitoring, troubleshooting, and ongoing enhancements.

Essential Skills


  • Experience designing and implementing complex Airtable architectures in production environments;
  • Deep expertise in data modeling and relational database design, automations and scripting using JavaScript, Interfaces and advanced workflow design, and permissions, governance, and enterprise-level structure;
  • Strong understanding of API integrations (RESTful APIs, webhooks, middleware such as Zapier and Make);
  • Proficiency in JavaScript for automation and integration scripting;
  • Experience integrating Airtable with external systems such as CRM platforms, loan management systems, accounting software, or document storage systems.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience building fintech, lending, or financial operations systems;
  • Experience with Salesforce CRM and integration;
  • Experience designing operational systems for loan origination or underwriting workflows.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.


Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.


How your day will look like/Job responsibility

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends


Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships


Knowledge:

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors


Skills:

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)


Attitude:

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.
